title: Operations Manager for Dfy ecom store growth program
description:
We’re Hiring: Ecommerce Operations Manager and Client success manager



Our company places store managers to run and grow our clients’ eBay, Amazon, and Walmart stores.



We’re looking for an experienced Operations Manager to oversee those managers, maintain service quality, and hold the team accountable for store performance.



**Previous experience personally managing dropshipping stores is required.** You must understand the work firsthand, including product research, listings, fulfillment, profitability, account health, and resolving account issues.



**Your responsibilities**



• Oversee store managers and verify they are completing listings, fulfilling orders, uploading tracking, and managing customer service correctly.



• Make sure every manager submits accurate end of day reports covering completed work, sales, profit, issues, and next steps.



• Review actual store activity to verify reports and identify problems early.



• Hold managers accountable for each store’s agreed targets, including monthly goals such as $5,000 in revenue and $2,000 in profit after the established ramp period.



• Create improvement plans for underperforming managers and remove or replace them when they consistently fail to meet expectations.



• Make sure clients receive clear updates, timely responses, and professional communication.



• Monitor account health and proactively reduce the risk of suspensions, restrictions, listing violations, and fulfillment issues through compliant operating practices.



• Lead the resolution of account suspensions and restrictions, including identifying the cause, gathering documentation, preparing appeals, and following through with platform support.



• Arrange paid appeal assistance when needed and coordinate payment within an approved company budget.



• Recruit, interview, and evaluate additional store managers.



• Train managers and verify their skills through practical assessments before assigning them real client stores.



• Maintain procedures, performance dashboards, and a smooth handover process when replacing managers.



**Required experience**



• Proven experience personally operating and growing dropshipping stores on eBay, Amazon, or Walmart. Clearly state which platforms you have managed.



• Strong knowledge of product research, listing optimization, supplier management, order fulfillment, and profit tracking.



• Experience preventing account issues and handling restrictions, suspensions, and appeals.



• Experience leading teams, reviewing performance, and holding managers accountable.



• Strong client communication skills, including handling concerns and explaining performance clearly.



• Ability to provide evidence of previous results and communication quality.



**How to apply**



Include **pineapple** in your application subject line.



Your application must include:



1. **Your experience:** Which platforms you have personally managed, how long you managed them, and how many stores and team members you have overseen.



2. **Proof of store results:** Screenshots or screen recordings showing previous store performance, including revenue, profit, and timeframes. Explain exactly what you managed and contributed to those results.



3. **Proof of communication:** Redacted examples of client updates, end of day reports, team instructions, or conversations where you handled a client concern.



4. **Account recovery experience:** Examples of suspensions or restrictions you handled, what caused them, what actions you took, and the outcome. Include supporting evidence where available.



5. **Your management approach:** Explain what you would do if a manager was completing daily tasks but their client’s store was not improving.



6. **Your availability:** Your time zone, available working hours, and expected compensation.



Remove client names, credentials, and confidential information from any examples you submit.



Applications without the subject line password and requested proof will not be considered.

title: Chief Operating Officer/Client Success Manager
description:
# Chief Operating Officer — Online Business



**Company:** Resell Signals / SellPilot

**Position:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Compensation:** Base salary plus performance incentives. $50k to $120k OTE



## About the Position



We are hiring an experienced, hands-on Chief Operating Officer to take ownership of the daily operations of our growing e-commerce education and software company.



**This is not a beginner position.**



Our company is already generating more than **$1 million per year**, and we need someone who has previously managed the operations, fulfillment, client success, and staff of an established online business.



We are not looking for someone who wants to learn how to operate a company. We need someone who has already done it successfully and can step in, identify problems, manage the team, improve systems, and help us scale.



You will be responsible for making sure the company runs properly every day, clients are supported and getting results, staff members are performing, and fulfillment is being completed at a high standard.



## Key Responsibilities



### Operations and Fulfillment



* Take ownership of all daily company operations.

* Oversee client fulfillment, customer support, client success, and service delivery.

* Make sure every client receives what they were promised.

* Monitor client satisfaction, results, retention, refunds, cancellations, and chargebacks.

* Identify operational problems and resolve them without waiting for the founder.

* Create and improve SOPs, workflows, quality-control processes, and reporting systems.

* Ensure the business can operate smoothly without constant founder involvement.

* Provide weekly reports covering client results, team performance, problems, and priorities.



### Team Management and Hiring



* Manage fulfillment, support, client success, and operational staff.

* Set clear expectations, deadlines, responsibilities, and performance metrics.

* Hold staff accountable and address underperformance quickly.

* Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and train new tea
mbers.

* Build strong department leaders who can manage their responsibilities independently.

* Ensure communication between sales, fulfillment, support, and marketing remains organized.



### Client Success



* Improve client onboarding, communication, support, and overall experience.

* Make sure clients are progressing and receiving measurable value.

* Identify inactive, confused, unhappy, or at-risk clients before they cancel.

* Resolve serious client problems professionally and quickly.

* Create systems that improve client results, retention, and satisfaction.

* Collect feedback, testimonials, case studies, and success stories.

* Make sure the sales team does not promise anything the fulfillment team cannot deliver.



### Systems and Growth



* Improve the company’s programs, software, services, and internal processes.

* Turn the founder’s ideas into organized projects, deadlines, and completed outcomes.

* Find opportunities to automate, delegate, or simplify repetitive work.

* Manage GoHighLevel, CRM automations, project management tools, and reporting dashboards.

* Identify new services, upsells, recurring revenue opportunities, and offer improvements.

* Monitor staffing requirements, fulfillment capacity, operational expenses, and profit margins.

* Prepare the company to handle more clients without lowering service quality.



### Content and Marketing



* Record one long-form YouTube video each week.

* Record short-form videos for Instagram and other social media platforms.

* Work with the marketing team on content, messaging, promotions, and campaigns.

* Help improve the company’s social media presence and positioning.

* Represent the company professionally and confidently on camera.



## Required Experience



Applicants should have proven experience:



* Managing operations for an established e-commerce, SaaS, coaching, education, or online service business.

* Overseeing client success, customer support, and fulfillment departments.

* Managing remote employees, contractors, and department leaders.

* Hiring, training, evaluating, and replacing staff when necessary.

* Creating SOPs, dashboards, quality-control systems, and performance scorecards.

* Managing a business with meaningful revenue, client volume, and operational complexity.

* Improving client retention, fulfillment performance, and team accountability.

* Making important decisions without constant founder approval.



## Preferred Experience



* E-commerce or online business operations

* High-ticket programs, coaching, digital education, or SaaS

* GoHighLevel and CRM automation

* Social media marketing and online advertising

* Sales funnels and digital products

* Client success and retention management

* Content creation and on-camera communication



## Who This Position Is Not For



This position is not suitable for someone who:



* Has only managed a small team or early-stage project.

* Is looking for their first operations leadership position.

* Requires constant instructions or supervision.

* Avoids difficult conversations with employees or clients.

* Has never managed fulfillment or client success.

* Only has theoretical knowledge of online business.

* Is uncomfortable being held accountable for company-wide results.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, you should be able to:



* Fully understand the company’s departments, offers, and fulfillment systems.

* Take daily operational responsibilities away from the founder.

* Establish clear performance metrics for every department.

* Improve client onboarding, support, results, and retention.

* Strengthen team accountability and communication.

* Identify staffing gaps and recruit stronger tea
mbers.

* Improve SOPs, reporting, automation, and quality control.

* Present a clear plan for scaling the company beyond its current revenue level.



## How to Apply



We are every single applications but Please submit:



* Your resume and a short introduction.

* The names and types of online businesses you have helped operate.

* The highest annual revenue level of a business whose operations you managed.

* The number of employees or contractors you directly managed.

* Your experience overseeing fulfillment and client success.

* Your experience using GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

* A short video explaining why you are qualified for this position. If no intro video, your application will be ignored

* Your desired compensation and availability.



Include the phrase and password **“I will scale your company”** in your application so we know you reviewed the full posting.

title: Accounts Specialist (Office-Based in Legazpi City, Albay)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and skilled AP/AR Specialist to join our team. This role is integral in managing our financial transactions related to accounts payable and accounts receivable functions. The AP/AR Specialist will be responsible for conducting credit card reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and maintaining accurate financial records using the Xero accounting software. This position demands a high level of accuracy, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment. 



Responsibilities 

Accounts Payable Management 

Process accounts payable transactions accurately and timely, including invoice verification, coding, and data entry into the Xero accounting system. 

Perform credit card reconciliation to ensure all transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled with corresponding invoices or receipts. 

Review and reconcile vendor statements, resolving any discrepancies or outstanding issues with payments. 

Prepare and process payment runs, including electronic transfers, checks, and ACH payments, according to company policies and payment terms. 

Communicate with vendors regarding payment inquiries, invoice disputes, and payment delays maintaining positive relationships. 

Accounts Receivable Management 

Generate customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring they include all necessary documentation and billing details. 

Record and reconcile customer payments received via various channels, such as checks, credit cards, and electronic transfers, ensuring accurate entry in the Xero accounting system. 

Conduct regular bank reconciliations to match customer payments with corresponding invoices, updating accounts receivable records as needed. 

Follow up on overdue invoices through
, phone calls, or written correspondence to facilitate timely collections and reduce outstanding balances. 

Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and escalate unresolved payment issues to management as necessary.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex 

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: PA and Office Administrator - Fully Remote (London Property Lettings)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION



We are a London-based property business managing a portfolio of around 25 long-term rental properties across the city. We are a small, hands-on team and this role is central to keeping the day-to-day running smoothly.



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES



* Assisting with the day-to-day administration of a portfolio of ~25 long-term rental properties in London.

* Reporting directly to the owner/director.

* Acting as the first point of contact for tenants: responding to enquiries, logging issues and following them through to resolution.

* Coordinating maintenance and repairs: taking tenant reports, getting quotes, booking contractors with our local London team and confirming work is completed.

* Tracking compliance documents and expiry dates (gas safety certificates, EICR, EPC, deposit protection, licences) and flagging renewals in good time.

* Coordinating property inspections three times a year with the local team, ensuring photographs are received and organised.

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping: logging rent payments, chasing arrears, and keeping expense records up to date.

* Maintaining and updating diary entries, files and property records.

* Occasionally helping outside normal working hours if there is an emergency.

* This description is an outline and is not intended to list all duties and responsibilities. It is subject to change based on the needs of the business.



ABOUT YOU



* Flexible approach.

* Quick, creative thinker.

* Great attention to detail.

* Polite and approachable manner.



REQUIREMENTS



* A minimum of 2 years' experience in an administrative or personal assistant role is essential.

* Experience in property lettings is required for this role.

* Comfortable taking on new tasks and learning new skills, with the ability to think on your feet, work independently, be proactive and remain self-motivated.

* Ability to work well under pressure.

* Competent, reliable, highly organised and efficient.

* Excellent IT skills, including good knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Word and Excel, and experience managing diaries.

* Experience using a lettings or property management database would be beneficial but is not essential.

* Ability to communicate and correspond clearly and accurately in English, both verbally and in writing.

* Honesty, integrity and care for the needs of the business.

* Ability to work on your own initiative and take responsibility for daily administrative operations.

* Reliable internet connection and a suitable workspace for remote working.

* Ability to work UK working hours from abroad.



HOURS AND WORKING MODEL



Normal working hours are 9am-5pm, Monday to Friday, plus a half-day on Saturdays. All working hours follow UK local time, including seasonal clock changes.



This is a fully remote role. There is no requirement to attend an office or visit properties in person.



Occasionally, overtime may be required during busy periods, which may mean finishing later than normal working hours.



SALARY



$600 USD per month.



Probationary period: 3 months.



Salary review: After completion of the probationary period.



EXPECTED START DATE



Ideally within 2 weeks.



Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Work Location: Fully remote, from abroad

Valére Growth Studio is a U.S.-based marketing agency working with dental practices and professional-service businesses nationwide.



We are looking for an experienced Digital Advertising Account Setup & Tracking Specialist to join our team in a long-term, part-time capacity.



We need someone who knows how to create, configure, connect, and troubleshoot advertising accounts across multiple platforms.



This is NOT a social media management, graphic design, or advertising strategy position.



Our team handles campaign strategy, budgets, creative, copy, targeting, and landing pages.



Your responsibility is to make sure the advertising accounts, campaign configurations, platform integrations, and conversion tracking are correctly established and ready to launch.



Advertising Platforms



We are looking for someone with hands-on technical experience across as many of the following platforms as possible:



Google Ads and YouTube Ads



Meta Ads 
 and Instagram)



Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads)



TikTok Ads Manager



Snapchat Ads Manager



LinkedIn Campaign Manager



Pinterest Ads



Reddit Ads



Programmatic and display advertising platforms



Other digital advertising and ad-serving networks



Google Ads and Meta Ads experience is required. Experience setting up additional advertising platforms is a major priority.



You do not need to be an expert in every platform, but you must have demonstrated experience setting up multiple advertising systems and be comfortable learning additional platforms.



Key Responsibilities



Advertising Account Setup



Create and configure new advertising accounts.



Review existing accounts before making changes or creating additional assets.



Set up business managers, account access, permissions, and business verification.



Connect agency and client advertising assets.



Coordinate billing configurations with our team.



Install and verify advertising pixels, tracking tags, and conversion events.



Troubleshoot account setup issues and platform integrations.



Campaign Setup



Build campaigns using instructions provided by our marketing team.



Configure approved budgets, locations, keywords, audiences, placements, and exclusions.



Upload approved ad copy and creative.



Connect ads to the correct landing pages.



Follow standardized naming conventions and campaign structures.



Prepare campaigns for review before activation.



Tracking & Integrations



Google Tag Manager (GTM)



Google Analytics 4 (GA4)



Google Ads conversion tracking



Meta Pixel and Conversions API



TikTok Pixel



LinkedIn Insight Tag



Snapchat Pixel



Microsoft UET



CallRail



Form submission and phone-call conversion tracking



You must be able to test tracking, identify duplicate conversions, troubleshoot broken integrations, and verify that advertising platforms are receiving the correct data.



Documentation & Quality Assurance



Maintain organized account setup checklists.



Document all completed configurations.



Test conversion events and landing-page functionality.



Identify missing information or configuration errors.



Communicate project progress and blockers clearly.



Submit completed setups for internal approval.



Required Qualifications



Proven experience setting up Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts.



Hands-on experience configuring at least two additional advertising platforms.



Strong working knowledge of Google Tag Manager and GA4.



Experience implementing and troubleshooting conversion tracking.



Understanding of advertising pixels, event tracking, and account permissions.



Experience working with multiple client advertising accounts.



Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.



Excellent written English communication.



Ability to follow technical instructions and complete work independently.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn, and Microsoft Advertising.



Experience with CallRail.



Experience working for a U.S. marketing agency.



Experience with dental, healthcare, or local-service advertising.



Familiarity with server-side tracking and conversion APIs.



Understanding of advertising-platform compliance and data privacy requirements.



Experience with programmatic advertising platforms.



What We Offer



Long-term, ongoing part-time work.



Flexible remote working arrangement.



Approximately 10 hours per week initially.



Opportunity for additional hours as our agency grows.



Clearly defined tasks and implementation requirements.



An established U.S. marketing team providing strategy, creative, and campaign direction.



Consistent opportunities to work across different advertising technologies and platforms.

title: Shopify VA Needed - Convert Existing Boutique Website to Custom Apparel Business
description:
Shopify VA Needed – Convert Existing Boutique Website to Custom Apparel Business



I’m looking for an experienced Shopify VA/designer for a one-time project converting my existing Shopify boutique website into a website for my custom apparel and embroidery business, CGB Customs.



My Shopify store is already established, but I am closing the retail/boutique side of my business and moving completely into custom work. I do NOT need a brand-new Shopify store built from scratch. I need someone who can clean up and transform the store I already have.



Project Scope



The project will include:



Remove/archive the existing boutique products and collections



Remove old boutique navigation, pages, banners and other outdated content



Help me select and set up a new domain for CGB Customs



Connect the new domain correctly to Shopify



Help reorganize the website around my custom business



Redesign the homepage using my existing branding/logo



Create clean navigation and service categories



Set up pages/sections for services such as:



Custom embroidery



Custom apparel/DTF printing



Hats



Team & school apparel



Business/company apparel



Personalized gifts and other custom items



Create a Request a Quote / Start a Custom Order workflow where customers can provide information, upload artwork if possible, and tell me what they need



Help determine which products/services should be directly purchasable online versus which should require a custom quote



Set up an
 capture/pop-up and integrate it with Klaviyo or another appropriate
 marketing platform



Make sure the website looks professional and functions correctly on both desktop and mobile



Set up basic SEO/page titles where appropriate



Test forms, links, checkout and mobile functionality before the project is considered complete



Leave the site organized so I can easily maintain products and content myself after the project is finished



About the Business



CGB Customs is a small custom apparel and personalization business. We offer embroidery, DTF printing, custom apparel, hats, team/school items, business apparel, personalized gifts and other custom products.



This is NOT a traditional ecommerce store where every possible customization will have its own product listing. I need someone who understands how to create a website that combines easy-to-order products with custom quote requests.



I am looking for someone who can make recommendations about the customer experience and site organization rather than simply waiting for me to tell you where every button should go.



Ideal Candidate



You should have experience with:



Shopify



Shopify themes/Online Store 2.0



Shopify product and collection organization



Custom or personalized-product businesses



Quote/contact forms



Domain setup



Klaviyo or similar
 capture/email marketing integrations



Basic Canva or graphic design



Mobile optimization



Basic Shopify SEO



Experience with embroidery, screen printing, DTF, promotional products or custom apparel businesses is a BIG plus.



Budget & Timeline



This is a project-based/gig position, not currently a full-time role.



Initial project budget: approximately $200 USD, but I am open to reasonable proposals depending on experience, portfolio and the scope you recommend.



Please include an estimated timeline with your application.



There may be additional Shopify work available in the future if this project goes well.



To Apply



Please send:



Links to 2–3 Shopify stores you have personally worked on and explain specifically what you did on each.



Your experience with Klaviyo and Shopify forms.



Whether you have worked with custom apparel, embroidery, printing, promotional products or another made-to-order business.



Your recommended approach for converting an existing retail Shopify store into a custom-order business.



Your estimated project price and timeline.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “CGB CUSTOMS” so I know you read the entire posting.



Please do not send a generic application. I am specifically looking for someone who can take an existing Shopify store, understand the new business model, and help me turn it into a simple, professional website that makes it easy for customers to either order or request a quote.

title: Client Success Manager - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Starting base: USD 1,500/month

- Certified CSM base: USD 2,000/month

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is based on consistent quality work and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 8 PM-11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process. It must be sustainable long-term.



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an "80% done-for-you" content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

We're currently looking for an experienced website designer and e-commerce developer to help us build a professional, modern, and visually appealing online store.







**This will begin as a PAID TRIAL PROJECT.**



We would first like you to create a website mockup showing your vision for our beauty supply store. We want something modern, clean, easy to navigate, and designed to convert visitors into customers.



Our goal is to eventually create a fully functional e-commerce website where customers can browse and purchase our products online.



**What we're looking for:**



1. **Website Mockup & Design:** Create a professional mockup of our future website, including the homepage, product pages, categories, and overall shopping experience.



2. **Branding & Aesthetics:** Use our existing branding, Instagram, and business identity to develop a visually appealing website that represents our store.



3. **E-Commerce Functionality:** Recommend the best platform and features for selling beauty supply products online.

For example, if a customer purchases an item online, we need to know whether that item is actually available in our store before accepting or fulfilling the order.

We're interested in solutions such as real-time inventory synchronization, automatic stock updates, low-stock alerts, and potentially a system that allows us to confirm availability before fulfilling orders.

We're not expecting you to build the entire website immediately.

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Sales Specialist (Remote)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a **highly skilled Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer** to join our team long-term.



This is **not primarily a cold-calling position**. Our marketing and lead-generation team identifies homeowners who have expressed interest in selling and pre-qualifies them before handing qualified opportunities to the Acquisition Specialist.



Your primary responsibility will be to speak with motivated homeowners, understand their situation, build trust, negotiate pricing and terms, follow up consistently, and ultimately **get profitable real estate contracts signed**.



We currently generate seller opportunities through multiple channels, including **iSpeedToLead, DataSift, SMS marketing, Smarter Contact, Kixie, and our CRM**. Our goal is to build a highly systemized acquisition department where qualified seller opportunities are contacted quickly and no valuable lead falls through the cracks.



Our primary transaction strategy is **novation**, followed by wholesale/assignment when appropriate. We selectively purchase properties ourselves when the profit opportunity is exceptional.



You will work closely with our current Acquisition Manager, operations team, lead-generation team, and company owner. Initially, you will learn our existing acquisition process and work alongside our current Acquisition Manager. The goal is for you to eventually become capable of **independently managing and closing qualified seller opportunities from beginning to end**.



### Responsibilities & Expectations



- Call qualified homeowners who have indicated an interest in selling.

- Respond quickly to newly qualified seller opportunities.

- Build rapport and uncover the seller's true motivation, timeline, condition, financial situation, and desired outcome.

- Negotiate purchase prices and transaction structures professionally and confidently.

- Explain cash offers, novation transactions, and other selling solutions clearly to homeowners.

- Maintain consistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready to make a decision immediately.

- Work leads through the CRM until they sell, contract with us, or are otherwise no longer viable.

- Use **Kixie** for outbound calling and follow-up.

- Maintain detailed CRM notes so another team member can immediately understand each seller's situation.

- Work closely with the lead-qualification team to improve the quality of leads being transferred to acquisitions.

- Bring complicated or unusually valuable opportunities to management for deal review.

- Participate in call reviews, coaching, and ongoing sales training.

- Become capable of covering for the Acquisition Manager when he is unavailable.

- Ultimately produce approximately **4–6 signed contracts per month** once fully trained and supplied with adequate qualified lead volume.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is **comfortable talking about money, asking difficult questions, negotiating, handling objections, and asking homeowners to make decisions**.



The ideal candidate has prior experience in **U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, investor sales, high-ticket telephone sales, or another negotiation-heavy sales position**.



Excellent spoken English is extremely important. You should sound natural, confident, professional, empathetic, and trustworthy when speaking with U.S. homeowners.



You should also be:



- Highly dependable and available during agreed U.S. business hours.

- Competitive but ethical.

- Persistent without being aggressive.

- Comfortable receiving coaching and having calls reviewed.

- Organized with strong CRM discipline.

- Able to follow a sales process while still thinking independently.

- Comfortable making numerous follow-up calls every day.

- Able to recognize seller motivation and negotiate creatively.

- Comfortable discussing property values, mortgages, equity, repairs, and seller expectations.

- Motivated by measurable results rather than simply completing tasks.



## What This Job Is NOT



This is not a position where success is measured by simply making a large number of calls.



We care about:



**Qualified seller conversations → signed contracts → closed transactions → gross profit.**



Our lead-generation team will do much of the initial prospecting and qualification. Your job is to take valuable seller opportunities and **convert them into contracts**.



## Training & Growth



You will initially work closely with our existing Acquisition Manager and review real seller conversations, successful deals, objection handling, negotiation strategies, and our novation process.



We are building redundancy into our acquisition department, so our objective is to have **multiple Acquisition Specialists capable of independently closing deals at a high level**.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on significantly more responsibility as the company grows.



## Schedule



**Full-time position.**



You must be able to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours and be available when homeowners are most likely to answer their phones.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.



## Compensation



**Competitive base compensation plus performance incentives/bonuses based on results.**



Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and demonstrated sales skill.



Top performers should have the opportunity to earn substantially more as their contract production increases.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short explanation of your previous sales, real estate, acquisitions, or negotiation experience.

2. Your experience speaking with U.S.-based customers.

3. Your experience using CRMs and telephone dialing systems.

4. Your experience with real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, novations, or motivated sellers, if applicable.

5. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful negotiating with U.S. homeowners.

6. Your desired hourly/monthly compensation.

7. Your internet speed and backup internet/power setup.

8. Put the words **“Acquisition Closer”** in the subject line of your application so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



**VOICE RECORDING MANDATORY**. Since this person's job is almost entirely seller communication,

title: Wholesale product sourcing
description:
**NOW HIRING: WHOLESALE HAIR & BEAUTY PRODUCT SOURCING SPECIALIST**



**Human Hair | Wigs | Private Label | Wholesale Distribution**



Hi, my name is Khairy Fiala, and I'm representing #1 NY Beauty, an established brick-and-mortar beauty supply store located in St. Petersburg, Florida, USA.



We're looking for an experienced wholesale sourcing specialist who can help us identify reliable manufacturers, negotiate competitive pricing, develop private-label products, and expand our purchasing and wholesale distribution opportunities.



**Human hair will be a major focus of this position**, including bundles, wigs, closures, frontals, and other hair extension products.



However, we're also interested in sourcing additional beauty supply products based on actual customer demand and sales performance at our store.



We currently use **Toast as our POS system**, which allows us to identify our best-selling products. We'd like to use this information to help determine which products are worth sourcing directly from manufacturers.



**1. HUMAN HAIR SOURCING — PRIMARY FOCUS**



We're particularly interested in:



- Raw and virgin human hair bundles

- Brazilian, Indian, Vietnamese, and other hair origins

- Straight, body wave, deep wave, and curly textures

- Burmese curly and specialty textures

- Human hair wigs, including 13x4, 13x6, and closure wigs

- HD lace and glueless wigs

- Closures and frontals

- Bulk human hair for braiding

- Colored and 613 blonde hair

- Custom lengths, densities, and textures



We want high-quality products with consistent manufacturing standards, competitive pricing, and opportunities for custom branding.



**2. SOURCING BASED ON OUR ACTUAL SALES DATA**



One of our biggest opportunities is using our existing sales history to identify products with strong demand.



We currently use Toast POS and can provide reports showing our top-selling products and categories.



We'd like someone who can analyze this information and identify opportunities to:



- Source our best-selling products at lower costs

- Find direct manufacturers for products we currently purchase through distributors

- Identify private-label alternatives to popular products

- Improve our profit margins

- Reduce unnecessary middlemen

- Negotiate better wholesale purchasing terms

- Identify products with potential for wholesale distribution



We want our sourcing decisions to be based on real customer demand rather than simply guessing which products might sell.



**3. PRIVATE LABEL & CUSTOM BRANDING**



We're interested in developing our own branded products, especially in categories where we already have strong customer demand.



This may include human hair, wigs, hair care products, styling products, accessories, and other beauty supply items.



We're looking for manufacturers that offer custom packaging, branding, product customization, and competitive minimum order quantities.



**4. WHOLESALE DISTRIBUTION OPPORTUNITIES**



In addition to purchasing products for our own store, we're interested in identifying products we can eventually sell wholesale to other beauty supply stores.



We want someone who can evaluate manufacturer pricing, shipping costs, landed costs, and potential wholesale and retail profit margins.



Our goal is to use our purchasing power and industry experience to develop profitable wholesale opportunities.



**5. MANUFACTURER RESEARCH & NEGOTIATION**



We're looking for someone who can:



- Find legitimate factories and manufacturers

- Verify supplier credibility

- Negotiate competitive pricing

- Compare product quality and specifications

- Request samples and catalogs

- Negotiate minimum order quantities

- Research shipping and import costs

- Identify long-term supplier opportunities

- Help us maintain consistent product quality



We're particularly interested in manufacturers in China, Vietnam, India, and other major manufacturing markets.



**6. PAID TRIAL PROJECT**



We'd like to begin with a paid sourcing trial before committing to an ongoing working relationship.



For the trial, we would provide selected product categories and potentially sales information from our Toast POS system.



We'd like you to:



1. Research our selected hair products and best-selling beauty supply items.

2. Identify reliable manufacturers or direct suppliers.

3. Compare wholesale prices, product quality, and minimum order quantities.

4. Explore private-label opportunities.

5. Calculate estimated landed costs and potential profit margins.

6. Recommend which products offer the strongest sourcing opportunities.

7. Present your findings in an organized spreadsheet or report.



We want customized research and actionable sourcing opportunities, not generic supplier lists.



**7. LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY**



If we're impressed with your trial, we'd be interested in an ongoing relationship where you help us:



- Continuously identify new manufacturers

- Negotiate better purchasing prices

- Source new hair products

- Analyze our best-selling products

- Develop private-label opportunities

- Coordinate product samples

- Identify profitable wholesale opportunities

- Improve our overall purchasing strategy



**IDEAL CANDIDATE**



We're looking for someone experienced in human hair sourcing, beauty supply manufacturing, international purchasing, private labeling, and supplier negotiations.



Experience working directly with hair factories would be a major advantage.



**PLEASE PROVIDE:**



1. Your experience sourcing human hair and beauty supply products.

2. The manufacturing countries and suppliers you work with.

3. Your experience with private-label products.

4. Your pricing for an initial paid sourcing trial.

5. Your pricing for ongoing services.

6. Your estimated timeline.



**BUSINESS INFORMATION**



Business: #1 NY Beauty  

Industry: Beauty Supply, Human Hair, Wigs & Cosmetics  

Location: St. Petersburg, Florida, USA  


  



Contact: Khairy Fiala  

Phone/WhatsApp: 
Country Code: +1 (United States)



We're open to working with qualified sourcing professionals internationally.



**IMPORTANT:**



We're not looking for someone who simply searches Alibaba and sends us links.



We're looking for someone who understands product quality, manufacturer relationships, pricing negotiations, and profitable wholesale sourcing.



**Our goal is to combine our existing retail sales data with strong manufacturer relationships to reduce purchasing costs, improve margins, develop private-label products, and expand into wholesale distribution.**



Thank you!

title: Senior SEO & Conversion Strategist
description:
We’re Ezy Pzy Finance, an Australian company that connects small and medium businesses with fast business funding through a panel of lenders. Our sales, automation and paid ads are mature and well run. Organic search is our biggest untapped channel, and we want one senior person to own it completely.



This is not a “do the tasks we give you” role. You’ll d
 the strategy, build the plan, execute it, and be measured on one thing: funded deals from organic search.





What you’ll own:



- SEO strategy: audits, keyword mapping and prioritisation for a competitive finance niche

- Programmatic and landing pages: industry, situation and location pages at scale, each with real substance

- Content: articles with genuine buyer intent, plus refreshing existing pages

- Digital PR and link earning: turning our real lending data into reports journalists and finance sites want to cite, plus partnerships with accountants and industry bodies

- Conversion optimisation: A/B testing our landing pages and application flow, which also serves our paid traffic

- AI search visibility: getting us cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity

- Technical SEO: site health, schema, speed and internal linking, writing specs for our developer when needed

- Reporting: a monthly report tying organic traffic to leads and funded deals, not vanity rankings





You must have:



- 5+ years of hands-on SEO, including owning strategy (not just executing someone else’s)

- Proven results you can show: traffic and lead growth with screenshots from Search Console or Analytics

- Experience in finance, legal, health or another YMYL niche (strongly preferred)

- Conversion rate optimisation experience (A/B testing, landing page work)

- Strong written English, good enough to write content for Australian business owners

- Comfort with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4 and WordPress





What we offer:



- US$2,000–3,000/month base, depending on experience

- Uncapped commissions: 10% of our net commission on every new client funded through organic search (our average deal pays US$300+ to you)

- Paid tools (Ahrefs or Semrush) and a separate budget for PR and outreach

- Real ownership: you set the plan, with no micromanagement

- A long-term role in a stable, growing business





Hours of work

6am–3pm PH time





How to apply:



- Start your message with the words “Organic Growth”, so we know you read this ad.

- Record a Loom video (max 10 minutes) auditing 
. Tell us the top 3 things you’d fix or build first and why, and what you’d deliberately not do.

- Share one case study with real numbers: what the situation was, what you did, and what happened to traffic and leads and how long it took.

- In 2–3 sentences, explain how you’d earn high-quality links for a finance company without buying them.

Applications without the Loom video won’t be reviewed.





If you’re a good fit, we’ll setup a Zoom interview to see if we’re a good fit to work together.

**Bond Baby | Beauty & Hair Styling Brand**



**Social Media • Influencer Marketing • E-Commerce • Wholesale • Product Development**



**Long-Term Opportunity | Remote Position | Paid Trial Available**



## ABOUT BOND BABY



Hi, my name is Khairy Fiala, and I'm the founder of Bond Baby, a beauty brand specializing in lace adhesives and hair styling products.



Website: 
  


  





Bond Baby currently sells products through our website and wholesale distribution channels.



Our main hero product is our **Bond Baby Lace Glue**, but we also have additional products and plans to expand into new categories.



We believe the brand has significant growth potential. However, due to our involvement in other businesses, we haven't been able to dedicate the time, attention, or resources necessary to properly scale it.



The brand is currently operating at a relatively low level of activity, and we're looking for someone who can help us change that.



**We're not looking for someone who simply posts on Instagram. We're looking for someone who can help us manage, develop, and grow the brand.**



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want a creative, organized, ambitious, and proactive individual who can take responsibility for developing Bond Baby's marketing presence and helping us execute a long-term growth strategy.



Ideally, this person would act as a combination of:



- Brand Manager

- Social Media Strategist

- Creative Director

- Influencer & UGC Coordinator

- E-Commerce Marketing Specialist

- Wholesale Marketing Coordinator

- Product Development Researcher



You don't necessarily need to personally perform every task, but you should be capable of organizing, managing, and coordinating the work required to grow the business.



## 1. SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT & CONTENT STRATEGY

Responsibilities include:



- Developing a consistent content strategy

- Creating weekly and monthly content calendars

- Planning Instagram Reels and TikTok videos

- Developing engaging content concepts

- Writing scripts for product demonstrations

- Coordinating video editing and graphic design

- Improving our social media branding and aesthetics

- Researching trends within the beauty and hairstyling industry

- Monitoring engagement and content performance

- Identifying opportunities to increase brand awareness and sales



We're particularly interested in authentic content featuring real hairstylists, wig installers, and beauty professionals using our products.



**We are not interested in relying on generic AI-generated videos.**



We want real demonstrations, creative marketing, and content that builds trust in our products.



## 2. INFLUENCER, COLLABORATOR & UGC MANAGEMENT



This will be one of the most important weekly responsibilities.



We want someone who can actively recruit, communicate with, and manage content creators who specialize in wigs, lace installations, hairstyling, and beauty.



Responsibilities include:



- Finding relevant influencers and content creators

- Contacting potential collaborators

- Negotiating gifted and paid collaborations

- Coordinating product shipments

- Providing creative briefs and content instructions

- Following up on content deadlines

- Collecting and organizing completed videos

- Ensuring we have permission to reuse content

- Tracking collaboration performance

- Maintaining ongoing relationships with successful creators



Our goal is to consistently generate high-quality content without requiring our management team to personally coordinate every collaboration.



## 3. ORDER COORDINATION & FULFILLMENT COMMUNICATION



We currently handle online and wholesale orders internally.



Our standard shipping days are:



**Monday and Saturday**

We want someone who can:



- Coordinate with our team regarding incoming orders

- Track which influencer and customer orders need fulfillment

- Organize product shipments for collaborators

- Communicate shipping priorities

- Follow up on delayed or outstanding orders

- Help improve our order management workflow

Responsibilities may include:

- Coordinating website graphics and promotional banners

.

 and SMS marketing opportunities

## 7. PRODUCT EXPANSION & MANUFACTURER RESEARCH



Our primary product is Bond Baby Lace Glue.



However, we're interested in expanding into additional product categories, potentially including products manufactured in the United States.



We're particularly interested in:



**Lace Adhesives**



Competitor references:

- Erica J

- Bold Hold



**Braiding Mousse**



Product references:

- Lottabody Mousse

- Vigorol Mousse



**Braiding Gels**



Product references:

- AllDay Locks

- Loc N Gel



**Edge Control**



Product references:

- Bask & Lather

- Pure Edge Control



These brands are references for understanding product categories, positioning, customer demand, and competition.



We're not looking to copy their branding or proprietary formulas.



We want to develop our own products that compete through quality, branding, pricing, and distribution.



We'd like someone who can help:



- Research potential product opportunities

- Identify manufacturers and private-label suppliers

- Explore U.S.-based manufacturing options

- Compare manufacturing costs and minimum order quantities

- Coordinate sample requests

- Research competitors and market positioning

- Help organize product development projects

- Support new product launches



Experience with beauty product sourcing or private-label manufacturing would be a significant advantage.



## 8. WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES & REPORTING



We're extremely busy managing other businesses, so organization and independent execution are essential.



We want someone who can establish a weekly workflow and keep us informed without requiring constant supervision.



A typical week may involve:



- Recruiting and communicating with content creators

- Coordinating influencer product shipments

- Managing the social media content calendar

- Reviewing and approving content for publication

- Creating or coordinating promotional materials

- Monitoring website and social media performance

- Following up on wholesale opportunities

- Researching new products and manufacturers

- Communicating with our fulfillment team

- Providing a weekly progress report



We want clear communication about what's been completed, what's in progress, what needs our approval, and what opportunities you've identified.



## 9. PAID TRIAL OPPORTUNITY



Before committing to a long-term working relationship, we're interested in starting with a paid trial.



**We want to see what you can specifically do for Bond Baby.**



We're not particularly interested in reviewing dozens of unrelated portfolio examples.



We would prefer someone who takes the initiative to research our website, Instagram, TikTok, products, and competitors.



For the paid trial, we'd like you to propose a customized project that demonstrates your ability to improve our brand.



Potential trial deliverables include:



1. A review of our current website and social media presence.

2. A proposed 30-day content and marketing strategy.

3. Five original content ideas with scripts or creative briefs.

4. Two or three sample promotional graphics.

5. A proposed influencer collaboration strategy.

6. A list of potential content creators relevant to our products.

7. Recommendations for improving our online and wholesale sales.

8. A brief analysis of potential new product opportunities.



We're open to discussing the scope and pricing before work begins.



**We want customized, actionable work, not generic marketing advice.**



## 10. LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



If we're impressed with your trial, we'd like to discuss an ongoing role managing Bond Baby's creative direction, marketing activities, collaborator relationships, and growth initiatives.



We want someone who can become an important part of the business and help build the systems necessary to scale.



We're open to discussing different compensation structures based on experience, responsibilities, and results.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



We're looking for someone who:



- Has experience with beauty or hair care brands

- Understands Instagram and TikTok marketing

- Has experience coordinating influencers and UGC creators

- Understands e-commerce and online sales

- Can develop creative marketing campaigns

- Has strong organizational and communication skills

- Can manage multiple projects independently

- Understands wholesale or retail distribution

- Can research new products and manufacturers

- Is proactive and results-oriented



**Most importantly, we want someone who can take initiative and make meaningful progress without needing constant direction.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please review our brand before contacting us.



Website: 
  


  





When reaching out, please include:



1. What you believe Bond Baby could improve immediately.

2. Your proposed approach to growing the brand.

3. Your experience managing beauty brands or similar businesses.

4. Your pricing for an initial paid trial.

5. Your pricing for ongoing management.

6. Your availability and expected weekly commitment.

7. One original idea you would implement for Bond Baby.



**Please don't send only a generic portfolio or copy-and-paste introduction.**



We're looking for someone who genuinely researches our brand and demonstrates that they understand our goals.



## CONTACT INFORMATION



**Brand:** Bond Baby  

**Website:** 
  


  


  



**Contact:** Khairy Fiala  

**Phone/WhatsApp:** 
**Country Code:** +1 (United States)



We're open to working with qualified professionals internationally.



## FINAL NOTE



Bond Baby already has products, an established brand identity, an e-commerce website, and wholesale distribution opportunities.



**What we're missing is consistent execution, creative direction, and someone dedicated to helping the brand grow.**



We're looking for someone who sees the opportunity, takes ownership of their responsibilities, brings creative ideas, and helps us turn Bond Baby into a stronger and more recognizable beauty brand.



We don't want someone who simply tells us what they could do.



**We want someone who shows us what they would do specifically for Bond Baby and has the ability to execute it.**



Thank you!

title: Part-Time Operations Assistant — Social Media & Outreach Support (Remote)
description:
Who we are



RenderVibe (
) is a small, founder-led software business. Our product turns ordinary real-estate listing photos into professionally staged renders, and we sell to realtors, brokerages, home stagers, photographers, and builders in the US and Canada. We are a small team, we work from written playbooks, and we are hiring one part-time operations assistant.



The job



You will run daily operations for our social media accounts and support our sales outreach. The work is precise, repetitive, and important. Everything is done from written instructions — your job is to follow them exactly, report exactly what happened, and flag problems the moment you see them.



Your duties:



- Set up, warm up, and operate social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok,
, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube) for a set of content personas, following a written playbook step by step

- Post approved content on schedule and log every action with live links

- Research real-estate businesses online and record their publicly published business contact details — accurately, with the source page for every detail

- Send outreach messages using word-for-word scripts we provide (you personalize only the parts the script marks)

- Keep a tracking sheet perfectly up to date: every account, every post, every message, every reply

- Send a written end-of-day report every working day, in our format, with live links — including days when the numbers are zero



What we need from you



- You follow written instructions exactly. If a script says send these words, you send these words. If a step can't be done as written, you flag it immediately and keep working on everything else — you never silently improvise and you never quietly skip it.

- You are honest about numbers. If you did 18, you report 18. If something you did doesn't match what you reported, you say so in the same report.

- You never guess contact details. If a business has not published an
 address, you write "none" and move on. A blank is always better than a guess here.

- You report daily, with links. "Done" is not a report. A link that can be clicked and checked is a report.

- Strong written English. You will send messages to North American businesses in the founder's name.

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and comfort with spreadsheets, Google Drive, and learning new tools (we will train you on our systems).

- Social media account management experience is a plus. Real-estate familiarity is a plus. Neither is required — precision and honesty are required.

- Sales or outreach experience is a strong plus — cold outreach, lead generation, appointment-setting, or follow-up work for a business. It carries a higher starting rate (see below). Describe it in Question 8.



Hours and pay



- Approximately 20 hours per week, remote, Philippines-based

- Work is mostly async, but some posting and reply windows are tied to North American business hours — say in your application which hours you can genuinely cover

- Rate: $6 per hour, paid via Wise. Candidates with proven sales or outreach experience start at $8 per hour.

- Start: the selected candidate starts in the second half of October 2026; the exact start date will be confirmed during selection



How to apply — read this carefully



Answer ALL of the screening questions below, in your application. Applications that skip any question will be ignored — this is the first test of the exact skill this job runs on.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid trial task (about 2–3 hours, paid via Wise on completion) before any offer is made. The trial uses real samples of this job's actual work. We hire from the trial results, not from interviews alone.



Screening questions:



1. Start your answer to this question with the exact words "I read it all:" — then tell us, in two or three sentences, about the most repetitive, detail-heavy task you have done for a client or employer.

2. A task in your written instructions cannot be done exactly as written — for example, a link is broken or a step is impossible on the platform. Walk us through exactly what you would do, in order.

3. You need a business's contact
. Their website has a contact form but no
 address published anywhere, and no
 on their social profiles either. What do you do? List what you would do and what you would not do.

4. Your end-of-day report says you sent 20 messages, but your breakdown by category adds up to 18. You notice this after sending the report. What do you do?

5. Rewrite this messy note as a clean 3-line status update: "so today i did the warmup for vanessa and sofia ig and tiktok, dre ig only because fb login problem again, posted vanessa reel, will fix fb tomorrow maybe."

6. Which social platforms have you personally managed accounts on, and what happened the last time an account you managed got restricted, flagged, or locked? (If it has never happened, say so.)

7. Which hours can you actually work each week (Philippine time), and what other jobs or commitments do you currently have?

8. Describe any sales, outreach, or appointment-setting experience you have: what you sold or promoted, who you reached out to, roughly how many outreaches you handled in a typical week, and what results you got. If you have none, say so plainly — honesty here counts for more than experience.

Sales and phone-based customer service for U.S. clients

Willing to work 7AM – 8PM CST (Chicago time)

Schedule & Pay

Part-time or Full-time (25 to 50+ hours per week)

 subject line: "Sales & Ops VA – [Your Name] – [Your Expected Rate]"

Your resume/CV and a screenshot of your internet speed test

Supportive and collaborative work environment

Access to ongoing training

title: Virtual / Personal Assistant to Home Care Startup Founder - Social Media, Appointments & Recruiting
description:
Must overlap US Central business hours (Austin, Texas). Long-term role with room to grow as our startup scales.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing home care startup based in Austin, Texas, serving seniors and their families. We're looking for a proactive Virtual / Personal Assistant to be the right hand of our startup's founder and small leadership team. You'll wear several hats - social media, appointment setting, caregiver recruiting support, and whatever else a fast-moving startup needs - to keep everything running smoothly.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Social media: run our content calendar - edit short videos, write captions, and schedule posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
 and 
; manage our Google Business Profile and review requests.

- Appointment setting & outreach: make calls and
s to book meetings for our business development lead, build and research referral target lists (hospitals, senior facilities, doctors' offices, case managers), and keep the calendar full.

- Recruiting support: post and refresh job ads, source applicants, screen resumes against a checklist, send screening questions, and schedule interviews.

- CRM & follow-up: log calls and meetings, set follow-up reminders, and draft thank-you notes for approval.

- Content & design: create simple marketing graphics and flyers in Canva and draft blog posts / newsletters.

- Admin & whatever's needed: calendar and inbox management, document organization, research, and other tasks to support the founder and team as we grow.

description:
FULL-TIME COPYWRITER FOR AN AMAZON RESELLING COACH (TRAINING PROVIDED)



Hi, I'm Saykho.



I run an online coaching business that teaches everyday people how to resell products on Amazon. I started in 2020 reselling on eBay, moved to Amazon, and have done over $5,000,000 in lifetime Amazon sales. Today I coach students, run live trainings,
 my list, and post content on Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube.



I'm hiring one full-time copywriter to write with me. You will write in my voice, to my audience, every day. All training is provided on the job. I care more about how you write and how you take feedback than about your resume.



**WHAT YOU WILL WRITE**



1.
s. Daily nurture
s, reminders for live trainings, launch sequences and promotions. Short, plain, story-driven, one call to action.



2. Short-form video scripts for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. 30 to 90 seconds each. Hook, setup, payoff, call to action. I film them, you write them.



3. Text-based Instagram Stories. Daily story sets (3 to 6 frames) built in Canva from templates I give you. Simple text on clean backgrounds, one message per frame, one prompt to DM or comment.



You will also help repurpose content across formats (a live training becomes an
, an
 becomes a script, a script becomes a story set) and keep our swipe file of winning hooks and subject lines organized.



HOW WE WORK



- Training is provided. You get my copywriting rules, my swipe file, recordings of my trainings, and feedback on every draft for your first 30 days. You do not need to know Amazon reselling to apply. You do need to be curious enough to learn it.

- Tools: Google Docs, Canva, Kit (our
 platform) and a team chat. If you have not used ConvertKit (Now named Kit), I will show you.

- Flexible hours. This is a 40-hour-per-week role, but you choose when you work, as long as deadlines are hit and you are reachable for a short daily check-in window we agree on together.

- Hourly pay with a simple time tracker.

- Long-term. I am hiring one person I can keep for years, not a project.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- Excellent written English. Conversational American English.

- You can write in someone else's voice and follow a style guide to the letter.

- You understand, or want to master, direct response copy: hooks, stories, specifics, one clear call to action.

- You know Canva basics (text, layouts, templates) or can learn them in a week.

- You are organized, meet deadlines without reminders, and take edits without taking them personally.

- Reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.



Nice to have, not required: experience writing
s for a coach, creator or online course; short-form scripting; familiarity with how Instagram Stories and Reels work.



PAY AND BENEFITS



- Starting pay: $3 to $5 per hour USD, depending on experience. That is roughly $480 to $800 per month at 160 hours.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, flexible schedule.

- 13th month pay.

- Paid biweekly via Wise or PayPal.

- Raises based on performance.

- Paid training from day one.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. I use it to see who pays attention.



1. Start your application with the word RAGOON as the first word on the subject line.



2. Answer these three questions in 1 to 3 sentences each:

   a) What is one
, ad or video that made you buy something, and why did it work on you?

   b) Describe your work setup and the hours you prefer to work (Philippine time).

   c) What is your experience with Canva, from zero to daily user?



3. Share 2 writing samples (links or pasted text).
s, scripts, captions, posts, anything you wrote yourself. If you have none, skip this and let the test speak for you.



4. Do this short test (15 to 20 minutes):

   Write one
 of 120 to 180 words to people who want to start reselling on Amazon but believe "Amazon is too saturated." Use this fact: Amazon does about $1.96 billion in sales every single day, and around 60% of that comes from independent sellers. End with one call to action to join a free live training.

   Then write 3 different opening hooks (one line each) for a 30-second video on the same topic.



5. Do not use em dashes anywhere in your application. Our house style never uses them.



6. Tell me your expected hourly rate within the $3 to $5 range.



Thanks you. I look forward to speaking soon.



Saykho

title: Logo & Brand Identity Designer for a Canadian Design Studio (Project-Based, Potential Ongoing)
description:
About the studio



I run a Squarespace web design and copywriting studio in Canada, working with therapists, clinics, consultants and other service businesses. I’m looking for a logo and brand identity designer to create brand packages for my clients.



This starts as project work, one brand at a time. As demand grows, I’d like it to become regular, ongoing work with the right person.



Your first project: a brand questionnaire

Before the first brand package, you’ll design a brand questionnaire in my studio’s branding, covering everything you need to know from a client to design well. You’ll build it once as a reusable template, and I’ll send it to each client. This is paid as its own small project.



How each brand project works



Gathering what you need: I send the client your questionnaire and pass their responses to you, along with notes from my discovery conversation. If you need anything clarified, send me one list of follow-up questions per project.



Style guide and logo direction: from the client’s answers, you create a style guide and logo direction: mood, colour palette, typography and 2 to 3 concept directions, so the client can confirm the feel before any logo is finalized.



Logo design: you develop the approved direction into a primary logo, secondary logo and submark or icon, with 2 rounds of revisions.



Final delivery: a finished brand guide and all files in standard formats (SVG, PDF, PNG, plus the working file).



I give creative sign-off at each stage. You’ll work from the client’s answers, my notes and my feedback.



Human-made design only



I’m hiring a designer who creates logos and brand identities by hand, without AI image or logo generators at any stage. My clients need to own their logo outright and be able to trademark it, and that requires original work built from scratch, with no AI-generated or stock elements.



What I’m hiring on



Strong logo and identity work, especially for professional service businesses where trust matters

Knowing what to ask before you design, and turning answers into a clear direction

Logos that work small (a website icon) as well as large

Range: you can design calm and soft for a therapist and confident and strong for a law firm

Organized and self-directed. You’ll manage each project from questionnaire to final files with minimal back and forth.



Nice to have, not required



Experience with website design or Squarespace

Experience designing for healthcare, wellness or professional services



White label and confidentiality

All work is white label. It goes out under my studio’s name and branding, belongs to the client, and can’t be shown in your portfolio or anywhere public. 



How to apply

Start your application with the word CEDAR.



Please write your application yourself, no AI replies please as I’d much rather read a few honest sentences in your own words, imperfect English included, than a polished reply written by AI. 



Then send me:



Your portfolio: links to at least three brand identity projects you designed (full brand guides or live brands, not single logos on mockups), and your role on each

Your quotes: one for building the brand questionnaire, and one for a full brand project as described above, with what’s included in each

Your questions: the five most important things you need to know from a client before you start designing a logo

Your process and tools: how you go from the client’s answers to your first concepts, and which tools you use

Your week: do you currently run your own design business or take on your own clients? Either answer is fine. I’d just like to know the shape of your week.

Your availability and timezone

Tell me about one logo you designed that you’d do differently today, and why.
