title: Lead Interior Designer & Team Lead
description:
About Us:

Snug Nest Designs is a premium Interior Design studio based in Melbourne, Australia. We provide end-to-end interior design and project management for people building their dream home, moving into a new home, or revamping an existing one. We are committed to enhancing quality of life through the power of exceptional design, and we believe every space should be a true reflection of its owner's personality and lifestyle. Our team works across Melbourne and the Philippines.



About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced, creative and highly organised Lead Interior Designer to join our team as a Team Lead. This is a hybrid role: you will lead a small number of residential design projects, and you'll be the day-to-day manager of our Philippines design team, responsible for allocating work, managing workloads and deadlines, coaching designers, and lifting the team's quality and efficiency.



You will report directly to the Founder and work closely with our Melbourne team. The ideal candidate is a strong designer who is equally comfortable leading people: clear in direction, organised, a patient coach, and eager to use technology and AI to improve how a design team works.



Key Responsibilities:



Team Leadership & Delivery:

• Day-to-Day Team Management: Lead the Philippines design team, assigning work, setting priorities, and making sure projects move forward on time.

• Workload & Capacity Planning: Manage workloads, deadlines and deliverables across all projects. Monitor and manage team capacity.

• Coaching & Design Quality: Give clear direction, feedback and hands-on guidance to junior designers. Review their work before it goes to the Founder for final approval, so quality and consistency improve over time.

• Goals & Performance Reviews: Set individual goals aligned with company goals, run monthly performance reviews, and support each designer's development and career growth.

• Cross-Team Collaboration: Stay closely aligned with the Founder and Melbourne team, with clear updates on progress, risks and priorities.

• Onboarding & Culture: Onboard new team members, train them on company SOPs and tools, and help build a positive, accountable and collaborative team culture.



Design Leadership:

• Project Leadership: Lead residential design projects from concept through to delivery, working closely with the junior designers to bring each design to life.

• Concept Development: Develop design concepts, mood boards, material palettes and client presentations aligned with client requirements and the studio's design direction.

• Space Planning & Design Development: Review architectural plans, create functional layouts and develop concepts into detailed designs, including custom joinery, feature walls and built-ins.

• 3D Modelling & Visualisation: Oversee accurate 3D models and presentation-ready visuals that communicate the design intent.

• FF&E & Material Sourcing: Coordinate sourcing of furniture, lighting, finishes and materials for your projects, including overseas suppliers such as those in China, covering pricing, specifications, samples and lead times.

• Technical Documentation: Review technical drawings, elevations, joinery details and specifications for accuracy and consistency before they are issued.

• Budget & Cost Management: Obtain and compare quotations, monitor project costs, and find design solutions that fit project budgets.



Process & Technology:

• SOPs & Process Improvement: Follow and refine company SOPs, templates and workflows to improve efficiency, consistency and delivery across the team.

• AI & Technology: Stay up to date with AI and emerging technologies, and actively use relevant tools to improve design development, research, documentation and team workflows, working alongside our automation lead.

• Reporting: Provide the Founder with clear, regular updates on team capacity, project status and upcoming deadlines.



Qualifications & Experience:

• Degree or qualification in Interior Design, Architecture or a related field. A professional licence is an advantage.

• At least 6 years of professional residential interior design experience, including at least 2 years leading designers or projects.

• Proven experience managing, mentoring or coaching designers, and managing workloads, timelines and deliverables across multiple projects.

• Strong understanding of residential interiors, space planning, materials, furniture, lighting and detailing.

• Experience with FF&E sourcing and supplier coordination.

• Strong 3D modelling and visualisation skills. Please include a portfolio link in your cover letter.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication, with confidence working directly with Australian colleagues and clients.

• Excellent attention to detail, strong organisation, and the ability to balance your own design work with leading a team.

• Comfortable working Australian business hours.



Software Proficiency:

• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Microsoft Office (including Excel), Google Workspace, and project management tools (ClickUp or similar).

• Experience with rendering software and AI-powered design tools is highly desirable.



What Success Looks Like:

• 1st month: You have taken over people management from our current leads, understand how the studio operates, have built strong relationships with the team, and are leading at least one project.

• 2nd month: You are managing the team's overall workload, distributing work, keeping projects on timeline, helping the team meet deadlines, and refining processes to improve efficiency.

• 3rd month: You are running the Philippines team's workload independently, with streamlined processes, clear visibility of capacity and deliverables, and the judgement to tell us when it is time to hire.



What We Offer:

• A leadership role in a growing premium design studio, working directly with the Founder.

• The chance to shape how the team works, including processes, SOPs and the use of AI and automation.

• Work on high-quality residential projects with clients in Australia.

• Compensation that is competitive and based on your experience.

• A clear path to grow as the studio grows.



How to Apply:



Please share:

title: Senior Accountant (CPA) – US Restaurant & SMB Clients | Day Shift | Path to Accounting Manager

HOURS PER WEEK: 20–30 to start (20 hours GUARANTEED), growing to 40



NO NIGHT SHIFT. Work Philippine daytime hours.



ABOUT US

We are a USA-based CPA firm providing outsourced accounting and finance services to US small and mid-sized businesses.



Our founder is a US CPA who spent 20 years in corporate finance leading IPO readiness, M&A, and capital raises. You'll learn directly from him.



We're adding clients quickly and need an experienced accountant to own the books for a growing client list. We are hiring for the long term, not a project.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

• Top-of-market pay WITHOUT the graveyard shift

• Guaranteed minimum hours from day one, not "hours TBD"

• Path to full-time: 90-day review, then conversion within 3–6 months for the right person

• Room to grow into Accounting Manager as we build the team



A note on the work: there will be hands-on transaction work at first, especially when onboarding new clients and cleaning up their books. But we're not hiring a data entry clerk. We're hiring someone who owns the close, catches what others miss, and finds ways to make the routine work faster. You'll get a firm-provided AI account, and we expect you to use it along with bank rules, Excel, and automation. The faster you get the routine work done, the more time you spend on analysis and client work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own full-cycle bookkeeping and the month-end close for US small-business clients in QuickBooks Online

• Close the books monthly and at year-end, and deliver clean, reconciled financial statements

• Record payroll and tips journal entries; reconcile payroll from Gusto, ADP, or Toast Payroll

• Process AP and code COGS by category

• Bank, credit card, loan, and balance sheet reconciliations, including sales tax payable

• Build the monthly reporting package: P&L, balance sheet, KPIs

• Flag anything that looks wrong and explain it clearly in writing

• Help us improve our processes as we grow. If something is slow or manual, tell us how to fix it.



MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of full-cycle accrual accounting, with at least 2 years serving US clients

• CPA firm, outsourced accounting, or client accounting services experience. You've handled multiple clients at once and owned their month-end close start to finish.

• Experience reviewing other people's work (staff, juniors, or offshore teammates)

• Expert in QuickBooks Online

• Strong US GAAP knowledge: accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, deferred revenue, balance sheet integrity

• Excellent written English. You can explain a variance to a restaurant owner who isn't an accountant.

• Reliable high-speed internet plus backup power/internet



STRONGLY PREFERRED

• Philippine CPA (US CPA also welcome)

• Multi-entity / multi-location clients

• Strong Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query a plus)

• You already use automation or AI tools to work faster, and can tell us how



SCHEDULE

Philippine daytime hours, flexible. We ask for a short live check-in at the start of your morning or end of your evening one to two days a week. Everything else is async.



WHAT WE OFFER

• USD $11–$14/hour based on experience, with an annual rate review

• Firm-provided AI tools for your work

• 20 guaranteed hours per week to start, increasing as our client base grows

• Full-time conversion package: paid leave / 13th month pay / HMO allowance

• Direct mentorship from a US CPA, with exposure to advisory, financial reporting, and transaction work

• Career path: Senior Accountant → Accounting Manager as we add team members (you'd help hire and train them) → leading our Philippines accounting team



DATA SECURITY

You will handle sensitive client financial data. An NDA and adherence to our data security policies are required. Client data may only be used in firm-approved systems, including your firm-provided Claude account. No client information in personal accounts, personal
, or unapproved software or AI tools.



---



HOW TO APPLY (incomplete applications will not be reviewed)



1. Use this exact subject line: "SMB Close – [Your Full Name]"

2. Attach your resume.

3. Include a 2-minute video (Loom or similar). Introduce yourself, then tell us about a time you found an error in a client's books: what it was, how you found it, and how you fixed it.

Create variations of successful organic videos for paid campaigns.

Required Qualifications

Strong short-form video editing skills, especially with CapCut or similar tools.



Experience managing
, Instagram, and TikTok.



Strong knowledge of ChatGPT and AI-assisted content creation workflows.



Experience reviewing social media analytics and recommending improvements.



Familiarity with Canva, Meta Business Suite, and social scheduling tools.



Good written English and the ability to recognize natural, engaging U.S.-focused marketing language.



Excellent organizational skills.



Ability to work independently, manage three brands, and take ownership of results.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.



Experience creating video advertisements for Meta campaigns.



Experience with GoHighLevel.

Experience improving AI prompts or automating repetitive marketing tasks.

Organized content calendars and media libraries.

title: U.S. STOCK OPTIONS DAY TRADER / SCALPER — EXPERIENCED TRADERS ONLY
description:
WE’RE HIRING SERIOUS TRADERS — NOT BEGINNERS



High Level Bosses is seeking an experienced, disciplined U.S. Stock Options Day Trader / Scalper who can independently identify high-probability trading opportunities, execute calls and puts, protect capital, and consistently follow a structured trading system.



We’re looking for someone who understands how to trade, not someone who needs constant supervision, reminders, or step-by-step instructions.



Forex, gold (XAUUSD), futures, and index traders are welcome to apply, provided they’re prepared to demonstrate U.S. stock options competency.



REQUIRED TRADING SKILLS



* Understanding of U.S. stock and ETF options, including calls, puts, strike prices, expiration dates, premiums, and contract sizing.

* Experience analyzing SPY, QQQ, TSLA, AAPL, or other liquid U.S. securities.

* Knowledge of opening-range breakouts (ORB), VWAP, support/resistance, price action, momentum, and market structure.

* Ability to identify entry and exit opportunities using technical indicators and price confirmation.

* Understanding of bid/ask spreads, liquidity, volume, open interest, and order execution.

* Ability to manage trades independently using predefined stop-loss and profit-taking rules.

* Understanding of options premium movement, including intrinsic value, extrinsic value, and time decay.

* Ability to recognize unfavorable market conditions and avoid unnecessary trades.



We prioritize disciplined execution and capital preservation over excessive trading.



PLATFORM REQUIREMENTS



Applicants must have experience with or demonstrate proficiency using:



* thinkorswim (TOS)

* Interactive Brokers (IBKR)

* Another platform capable of simulated U.S. options trading



You must be able to access a working paper-trading environment and demonstrate buying and selling U.S. calls and puts.



Platform access must be verified before the practical evaluation begins.



TRADING EVALUATION



Selected applicants will complete a five-day simulated trading evaluation under our company trading guidelines.



Evaluation conditions:



* Maximum $300 simulated capital allocation, regardless of the paper account’s displayed balance.

* U.S. stock/ETF options trading only.

* Defined risk limits and mandatory exit discipline.

* No unauthorized position sizing or excessive risk-taking.

* No revenge trading, impulsive entries, or unnecessary trades.

* All trades must follow our provided risk and execution manual.

* Every position must be documented with entry, exit, contract details, timestamps, and realized profit/loss.



Paper trading only during the evaluation. No real capital will be used.



COMMUNICATION & ACCOUNTABILITY — NON-NEGOTIABLE



We require consistent, professional communication.



You must:



* Be ready and available at the scheduled session start.

* Immediately report any delays, connection problems, or platform issues.

* Provide screenshots of trade entries, open positions, exits, and performance without repeated reminders.

* Respond promptly to management during trading hours.

* Follow written instructions and company trading procedures.

* Never disappear during a scheduled trading session without communication.



Unexplained absences, repeated delays, missing trade documentation, or unauthorized trading activity may result in immediate evaluation termination.



WHO WE WANT



An independent trader who:



* Can identify quality setups without being told what to trade.

* Understands when to enter, exit, and stay out of the market.

* Protects capital before pursuing profits.

* Can explain every trading decision.

* Takes accountability for both winning and losing trades.

* Is dependable, coachable, and capable of following established procedures.



CAREER GROWTH OPPORTUNITY — PART-TIME TO FULL-TIME



This position starts part-time, with the opportunity to advance into a full-time role based on demonstrated trading performance, consistency, reliability, and adherence to company risk-management guidelines.



We’re looking to build a long-term trading team. Candidates who successfully complete the evaluation and consistently demonstrate profitable, disciplined execution will be considered for expanded responsibilities, increased hours, and full-time employment.



Our objective is to develop successful traders into long-term members of High Level Bosses.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your years of trading experience and the markets you’ve traded.

2. Your experience trading U.S. stock options, including calls and puts.

3. The trading platforms you’ve personally used.

4. Your preferred technical indicators and intraday trading strategies.

5. Whether you currently have access to a working U.S. options paper-trading platform.

6. Confirmation that you’re available Monday–Friday, 9:30–11:30 AM Eastern Time.

7. A brief example of a recent trade, including your entry rationale, risk management, and exit.



Qualified applicants will receive a technical screening assessment, followed by a Zoom interview and practical trading evaluation.



We are building a team of disciplined, accountable traders who can deliver consistent execution—not just impressive résumés.



High Level Bosses

Trading Operations & Management

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Job title: Part-Time Full-Stack Developer (Next.js / TypeScript / PostgreSQL), Remote



Type of work: Part-time (about 20-25 hours per week)



About us

Ultim AI Solutions is a boutique software development company based in Israel, specializing in AI-oriented solutions. We build and maintain custom web platforms for our clients, from learning platforms to business applications, many of them with AI features at their core.



We're a small team, which means your work matters and gets noticed. You'll work directly with the founder, who handles all client communication, so you can focus on writing good code.



What you'll do:

- Build new features on existing client projects, including a learning platform and a production business app.

- Maintain and support live applications: fix bugs, handle small change requests, keep things stable and up to date.

- Help deliver new projects as they come in.

- Turn specs and task descriptions into working, tested code, and ask questions early when something is unclear.

- Write clear pull requests and short progress updates so the founder always knows where things stand.



Our stack:

- Frontend / framework: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

- Auth: Clerk

- Database: PostgreSQL (NeonDB), with an ORM such as Prisma or Drizzle

- Caching / queues: Redis (Upstash)

- Hosting / deployment: Vercel, Railway, GitHub

- AI in our products: integrations with LLM APIs (experience is a plus, not a must)



Requirements:

Juniors are welcome, as long as you have real production experience and work like a professional. This is not a role for beginners or a side gig to learn on.



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

- 2+ years of professional experience building web apps with Next.js, React and TypeScript.

- Hands-on experience with Clerk for authentication (users, sessions, middleware, webhooks).

- Solid experience with PostgreSQL, ideally on NeonDB, and an ORM (Prisma, Drizzle or similar).

- Experience deploying apps on Vercel (environment variables, builds, logs, debugging failed deploys).

- Experience working on production systems with real users: you've shipped features, handled bugs in live apps, and understand what it means not to break production.

- Basic system design skills: you can plan a feature end to end (data model, API, auth, caching) and explain the trade-offs.

- Comfortable working in an existing codebase you didn't write: reading it, understanding it, and changing it without breaking things.

- Good Git habits: branches, pull requests, meaningful commit messages.

- Good written and spoken English. Most of our communication is written.

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and a quiet place to work.

- Your own AI coding tool subscription. We work with AI-assisted development, and you bring your own tool: Claude Code or Codex. Other tools can work too, but let's discuss it first. We do not provide AI tool accounts.

- You can be available during the overlap hours below.



Strongly preferred (a big plus):

- Experience with Redis, ideally Upstash (caching, rate limiting or queues).

- Experience deploying and running services on Railway.



Nice to have:

- Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) or building AI features.



Working hours:

- About 4-5 hours a day, around 20-25 hours per week.

- We're in Israel (UTC+2 / UTC+3 in summer), which is 5-6 hours behind the Philippines.

- We need you available for at least 3 hours of overlap, roughly 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM Philippine time on working days. The rest of your hours are flexible.



How we work together:

- First month is a trial period. It's a real paid month of real work, so we can both see if this is a good fit.

If it goes well, we continue month to month.

- With consistently good performance over time (around six months), there is a possibility of moving to full-time.

- You'll get proper onboarding: existing documentation, walkthroughs of each project, and direct access to the founder for questions.



How to apply:

Please send your CV (PDF) together with a reply that includes:



- A short introduction (a few sentences) about yourself and your experience.

- Links to your GitHub and/or 1-2 projects you built with Next.js, with a sentence on what you personally did in each.

- One production system you worked on: what it does, roughly how many users it had, and what you were responsible for.

- Which of these you have used in a real project: Clerk, NeonDB, Upstash Redis, Vercel, Railway. One line each on what you did with it.

- Your expected monthly rate for 20-25 hours per week.

- Your availability for the overlap hours above.

- Which AI coding tool you use (Claude Code, Codex or other).



Important: Start your application with the words "NEON STACK" in the subject or first line. Applications without it, or without a CV, will not be reviewed. This helps us know you actually read the post.



We look forward to hearing from you!

## About the Role



As our Virtual Reservations Agent, you will be a primary point of contact for guests, helping them from their first inquiry through their post-stay experience.



Reporting directly to the business owner, you will manage reservations, answer guest questions, coordinate with our operations team, and resolve concerns within established guidelines. This is an active, guest-facing position that requires sound judgment, attention to detail, and ownership of follow-through.



**Previous experience in hotel reservations, hotel front desk operations, or vacation rental guest services is required.**



## Key Responsibilities



### Guest Communication and Reservations



- Respond promptly and professionally to inquiries through Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, our direct website, SMS,
, and phone.

- Manage reservations, modifications, cancellations, and payment questions according to company policies.

- Provide accurate information about properties, availability, amenities, check-in procedures, policies, and local recommendations.

- Follow up on booking inquiries and identify appropriate upsell opportunities.

- Handle cancellation requests and disputes thoughtfully, protecting revenue while maintaining professional guest service.



### Listing Quality Control



- Check listings for accurate amenities, descriptions, policies, and pricing.

- Flag discrepancies promptly and make authorized updates.



### Operational Coordination



- Communicate new bookings, reservation changes, and special requests to cleaning and field teams.

- Escalate maintenance concerns and urgent guest issues promptly, with clear details.

- Maintain accurate reservation notes, task updates, and shift handoffs.

- Follow up on open issues to help ensure timely resolution.



### Guest Experience and Issue Resolution



- Handle concerns calmly, professionally, and with empathy.

- Resolve issues within your authority and escalate situations that require approval.

- Follow up with guests to confirm their concerns have been addressed.

- Request post-stay reviews and assist with professional responses to guest feedback.



## Required Qualifications



- At least one year of experience in hotel reservations, hotel front desk operations, or vacation rental reservations or guest services.

- Excellent written and spoken English, including clear, professional phone communication.

- Experience handling guest inquiries, reservation changes, and complaints.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations and software systems accurately.

- Ability to work independently while following procedures and escalation guidelines.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup plan for internet or power outages.

- High integrity and discretion when handling guest, homeowner, and company information.

- Availability for the full scheduled shift.

- Willingness to use Hubstaff for time tracking and activity monitoring during working hours.



## Preferred Software Experience



Experience with the following is helpful, but not required:



- Streamline PMS

- Breezeway

- RingCentral

- Airbnb, Vrbo, and 
 dashboards

- Slack

- Hubstaff



Training on our systems and procedures will be provided. Applicants should already have a foundation in hotel or vacation rental guest service.



## Schedule and Work Expectations



- The schedule follows California local time, including daylight saving time changes.

- You must be available, responsive, and focused on assigned duties during scheduled working hours.

- Hubstaff is required for time tracking and activity monitoring.



## Compensation and Benefits



- $5.00 USD per hour, paid every two weeks.

- Fully remote work with a consistent schedule.

- Long-term opportunity with room for growth.

- Direct training and mentorship from the business owner.

- Performance-based opportunities for pay increases and expanded responsibilities.

- 13th-month pay.

- Potential for additional shifts as the company grows.



## Who Will Succeed Here



You will be a strong fit if you take initiative, communicate clearly, stay calm under pressure, and follow tasks through to completion. We value people who notice details, ask thoughtful questions, and take responsibility for the guest experience.



High performers may grow into reservations management, operations coordination, revenue management support, or team leadership roles.



## How to Apply



Please submit:

title: Remote Appointment Setter for a US Real Estate Education Company (High-Ticket, US Hours)
description:
Job overview



XSITE Capital Academy is a multifamily real estate education and mentorship company based in Columbia, Maryland, USA. We teach people how multifamily real estate works: finding markets and properties, underwriting, due diligence, financing and asset management. Our programs are taught live online by our founders, Leslie Awasom and Tenny.



We're looking for a warm, organized appointment setter to talk with people who have shown interest in our programs and book them onto calls with Leslie and Tenny. You won't be selling or closing. Your job is to start good conversations, answer basic questions about how our programs work, and get the right people onto the calendar.



You'll book calls for three programs:



- Vanguard Multifamily Accelerator ($4,997): a 10-week live online cohort with Leslie and Tenny.

- Vanguard Core Mentorship ($45,000, 12 months): a 30-minute discovery call is required before enrolling.

- Vanguard Elite Mentorship ($65,000, 18 months): a 30-minute discovery call is required before enrolling.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with a small, hands-on US team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Reach out to new leads quickly through phone calls, text messages and Instagram or
 messages.

- Have friendly, real conversations to understand what each person wants to learn and whether a program fits.

- Book qualified leads onto Leslie and Tenny's calendar for Accelerator calls and Core or Elite discovery calls.

- Send confirmations and reminders so booked calls actually happen.

- Follow up with leads who haven't booked yet, and with no-shows to reschedule.

- Keep every lead, note and status up to date in GoHighLevel.

- Share a short end-of-day report: conversations, calls booked, shows and follow-ups.

- Flag questions you can't answer to Leslie or Tenny instead of guessing.



RULES YOU MUST FOLLOW (THIS MATTERS TO US)



XSITE Capital Academy sells education only. We do not sell investments.



- Never promise income, returns, cash flow, deals or results of any kind.

- Never promise access to any property, deal or investment.

- Never give investment, legal, tax or financial advice.

- Never describe XSITE as an investment company or a way to invest.

- Use only the approved scripts and answers we give you. If you're unsure, ask us.

- Respect every "no" and every opt-out (for example a text reply of STOP).



REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience setting appointments for US high-ticket offers (coaching, courses, consulting or similar).

- Strong written and spoken English. You're comfortable chatting with US clients by message and by phone.

- Able to work US Eastern hours: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM ET and Saturday 10 AM to 4 PM ET.

- Reliable, fast internet plus a backup connection and backup power (UPS or generator).

- A quiet workspace and a good headset.

- Organized, coachable and consistent with follow-up.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with real estate, investing education or coaching offers.

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).

- Experience booking discovery calls for $5,000+ programs.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS (KPIs)



- Calls booked: at least 20 qualified calls booked per week (bonus).

- Show rate: 70% or more of booked calls actually happen (bonus).

- Speed to lead: how fast you reach a new lead after they come in.

- Follow-up: every lead gets the agreed follow-up steps, logged in GoHighLevel.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send all of the following. Applications missing any part won't be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the code word VANGUARD in the subject or first line.

2. Answer these two questions in a few sentences each:

   - Tell us about the high-ticket offer you set appointments for most recently. What was the price, and roughly how many calls did you book per week?

   - A lead asks you, "How much money will I make if I join?" What would you say?

3. Send a 1 to 2 minute voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a good fit for this role.

4. Tell us your current internet speed and your backup power setup.



We look forward to hearing from you.
salary: $6 to $8 per hour plus KPI bonuses

title: Appointment Setter and Outbound Caller
description:
We’re looking for an Outbound Sales Development Representative with a strong focus on outbound calling and appointment setting to build pipeline for a fast-moving B2B sales intelligence platform. You’ll call and prospect into SMB and mid-market accounts, use
 and LinkedIn to support your outreach, qualify prospects, and book well-prepared meetings for the sales team.



This is a phone-forward, high-activity role. You’ll follow a clear outbound playbook, make consistent calls, handle objections, and guide promising conversations toward a scheduled meeting. You’ll also use AI tools daily to research accounts and personalize outreach so you can work efficiently without sacrificing quality.



If you’re a confident communicator with strong English skills, enjoy outbound calling, and have a track record of setting qualified appointments, this role could be a strong fit.



Why You’ll Want to Join

	• Holidays are observed per company guidelines.

	• Weekend shifts rotate across Opener, Mid, and Closer shifts to provide 24-hour coverage. Exact schedules are confirmed before your start date.

	• Work at the front end of the pipeline for a B2B platform with strong case studies and real customer traction.

	• Take ownership of outbound activity and appointment setting that directly supports revenue and growth.



What You’ll Work On



Outbound Calling and Appointment Setting

	• Open conversations confidently, identify prospect needs, and communicate the value of the platform.

	• Handle objections professionally and keep conversations moving toward a qualified, booked meeting.

	• Schedule appointments for the sales team and confirm meeting details with prospects.

	• Use
 and LinkedIn to support call outreach, follow up with prospects, and improve meeting conversion.

	• Keep prospects engaged through the handoff to the sales team.



Prospect Research and Qualification

	• Research accounts and prospects using the platform’s sales intelligence tools and AI-assisted research.

	• Qualify prospects against defined ideal customer profile (ICP) criteria before booking meetings.

	• Capture relevant discovery details and qualification notes so the sales team is prepared.

	• Maintain accurate records of calls, follow-ups, and pipeline activity in the CRM.



AI-Enabled Outreach

	• Use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily to research accounts, prepare for calls, draft personalized follow-ups, and improve efficiency.

	• Test and refine call approaches and messaging based on response data and feedback from the sales team.

	• Stay current on AI tools that can improve prospecting speed and quality.



Pipeline Tracking and Handoff

	• Track call volume, connection rates, response rates, and meeting conversion metrics consistently.

	• Coordinate scheduling and follow-up to reduce missed meetings and keep prospects engaged.

	• Provide clean, accurate handoffs with context and qualification notes for every booked meeting.



What You Bring

	• Prior SDR, outbound sales, appointment setting, or lead generation experience, with a track record of booking meetings.

	• Strong spoken and written English communication skills. This is essential for a phone- and
-focused role.

	• A confident, professional phone presence and the ability to handle objections and rejection while maintaining momentum.

	• Comfort using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily for research, call preparation, drafting, and outreach personalization.

	• Experience using CRM platforms to log activity and manage a pipeline.

	• A self-directed, disciplined approach and the ability to meet daily activity targets independently.

	• Availability to work three weekdays plus both Saturday and Sunday on a rotational shift basis. This is a firm requirement.



Nice to Have

	• Experience selling to SMBs in industries such as HVAC, dental, restaurants, or similar markets.

	• Familiarity with sales intelligence or data enrichment platforms.

	• Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar tools.

	• A background in B2B SaaS or go-to-market roles.



How to Apply



Please include:

	1. Your updated resume.

	2. A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your outbound calling and appointment setting experience, and showing how you use AI tools to research a prospect and personalize your outreach before a call.



Only candidates who submit a Loom video will move to the next step of the hiring process.

If you’re a confident communicator who enjoys outbound calling, knows how to turn prospect conversations into qualified appointments, uses AI to work efficiently, and can work weekends as part of your regular schedule, this role offers clear expectations and a direct impact on the sales pipeline.

title: SENIOR ACCOUNTANT / CPA – QUICKBOOKS ONLINE
description:

Remote – Philippines | 20–25 Hours Weekly | U.S. Manufacturing Company



Minimum 5 Years Experience | QBO Expertise Required



We are an established U.S. manufacturing company, is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Senior Accountant / CPA to manage monthly accounting, review expenses, and ensure financial accuracy following our migration from QuickBooks Desktop to QuickBooks Online.



We need an experienced accountant who investigates problems, questions expenses, and takes ownership — not someone who simply enters transactions.



Key Responsibilities



QuickBooks Online & Migration Review



Audit migrated transactions and account balances from QuickBooks Desktop to QBO.



Review previously memorized and recurring transactions for accuracy, necessity, and proper setup.



Identify missing, duplicate, unmatched, or incorrectly categorized transactions.



Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies.



Confirm that migrated accounting records are accurate and complete.



Monthly Book Closing



Complete monthly closing and account reconciliations on schedule.



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, AP, AR, and balance sheet accounts.



Review journal entries, accruals, and financial statements.



Prepare monthly financial reports and reconciliation schedules.



Maintain a list of unresolved accounting issues.



Expense & Vendor Auditing – HIGH PRIORITY



Review vendor invoices, recurring charges, subscriptions, and operating expenses.



Verify that charges are legitimate, accurate, authorized, and necessary.



Identify duplicate payments, unnecessary subscriptions, incorrect billing, and overcharges.



Compare invoices with contracts, pricing agreements, and payment history.



Question expenses lacking documentation or a clear business purpose.



Prepare a monthly expense audit report identifying discrepancies and potential savings.



CFO Coordination



Work directly with our fractional CFO team.



Research and respond to monthly accounting questions.



Investigate discrepancies and provide supporting documentation.



Proactively identify financial issues requiring management attention.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 5 years of verifiable professional accounting experience.



CPA qualification preferred.



Advanced QuickBooks Online experience — mandatory.



Strong U.S. accounting and GAAP knowledge.



Proven monthly closing and reconciliation experience.



Experience auditing expenses, vendor payments, and recurring charges.



Strong Excel skills and excellent English communication.



Manufacturing or inventory accounting experience preferred.



Work Schedule & Accountability



PART-TIME: Approximately 20–25 hours per week



This position requires dedicated, agreed-upon working hours with availability for scheduled meetings with our U.S. management and CFO team.



We have experienced issues with remote workers misrepresenting their availability and working hours. Our expectations are straightforward:



No working for another employer or client during hours paid by our company.



You must be actively working and responsive during your scheduled shift.



TimeProof is mandatory for time and activity tracking.



Payoneer is our exclusive payment method.



Reliable internet, backup connectivity, and prompt communication are expected.



Breaks, absences, and downtime must be reported accurately.



Repeated unexplained absences, falsified time records, or misrepresentation of availability will not be tolerated.



Other employment outside our scheduled hours is permitted, provided it does not interfere with your responsibilities, availability, or performance.



We respect legitimate illness and emergencies but require professional communication and accountability.



Performance Expectations



Monthly books closed accurately and on time.



Reconciliations completed with documented outstanding items.



Recurring expenses reviewed for accuracy and necessity.



QBO migration discrepancies identified and resolved.



Monthly expense exception report delivered to management.



CFO questions answered promptly and thoroughly.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Years of professional accounting and QBO experience.



CPA status and relevant credentials.



Experience migrating QuickBooks Desktop to QBO.



Your process for completing monthly book closing.



How you identify duplicate payments, unnecessary subscriptions, and incorrect vendor charges.



Experience working with U.S. companies and fractional CFO teams.



Your availability for 20–25 dedicated hours weekly.



Confirmation that you agree to TimeProof and Payoneer.



Your expected hourly rate in USD.



Begin your application with "QBO ACCOUNTABILITY." Generic or incomplete applications will not be considered.



We are seeking a dependable, experienced accounting professional who protects company money, identifies mistakes, and takes responsibility for accurate financial records.

title: Marketing Strategist & Creative Director
description:
Marketing Strategist & Creative Director



Position: Independent Contractor | Project-Based | Remote

Compensation: Fixed Project Fee — Submit Your Proposal

Opportunity: Potential Long-Term Contractual or Full-Time Position



About TKS Global Solutions

TKS Global Solutions provides business support services to contractors and tradespersons in the construction industry.  Our services include website development, administrative support, business systems, and operational solutions that help small contractors build professional, organized, and sustainable businesses.



The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Marketing Strategist & Creative Director to develop and lead our marketing efforts, beginning with a campaign promoting TKS Global Solutions' website development services.



We are looking for a professional who can establish our marketing direction from the ground up, identify the most effective ways to reach our target audience, develop compelling advertising concepts, and oversee campaigns that generate qualified leads and convert prospects into paying customers.



We need someone who understands marketing strategy, advertising psychology, persuasive messaging, professional graphic design, customer behavior, and conversion strategies.  This is a strategic and creative leadership position—not simply a graphic design or social media posting role.



The selected contractor will work with our existing team, providing the strategic direction, advertising concepts, creative leadership, and oversight necessary to execute effective marketing campaigns.



We expect the contractor to bring independent professional judgment, proactively identify opportunities and challenges, and recommend the direction and approach most likely to achieve our business objectives.



Initial Project Responsibilities

The selected contractor will be expected to:

• Develop an original marketing strategy for promoting TKS Global Solutions' website development services.

• Research our target audience and determine the most effective advertising channels, positioning, and promotional approaches.

• Develop compelling campaign concepts, persuasive advertising messages, headlines, offers, and calls to action.

• Establish the creative direction and professional visual standards for campaign materials.

• Provide detailed creative guidance to existing personnel responsible for graphic production, website updates, and campaign implementation.

• Review advertising materials and provide specific, actionable design feedback.

• Direct and oversee campaign implementation, monitor performance, and recommend improvements.

• Evaluate campaign results and provide recommendations for future marketing efforts.



The initial objective is a 30-day website marketing campaign.  Candidates are expected to independently assess the project requirements and recommend an appropriate strategy, scope, and timeline.



What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate has:

• Proven experience developing marketing strategies and successful advertising campaigns from concept through implementation.

• Strong knowledge of advertising psychology, persuasive copywriting, and lead generation.

• Advanced understanding of professional graphic design, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and composition.

• Experience directing creative work and providing constructive design feedback.

• Knowledge of digital advertising platforms, particularly
, Instagram, and Google.

• Understanding of landing pages, customer conversion, and campaign performance measurement.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong independent judgment, initiative, problem-solving abilities, and leadership skills.



Experience marketing to contractors, construction companies, or other service-based businesses is a plus.



Important: We value original creative thinking and professional design expertise. We are not seeking someone who relies primarily on generic Canva templates or AI-generated graphics.  AI may support the creative process, but it should not replace professional judgment.



Project Pricing Proposal

We are requesting fixed-price proposals for the initial website marketing campaign.

Applicants must provide a written proposal identifying the total fixed professional fee, in U.S. dollars, for completing the entire initial engagement, including strategy development, creative direction, campaign oversight, performance monitoring, and final reporting.



The proposal must identify:

1. Total project price.  The amount you would charge in U.S. dollars for the proposed project.

2. Proposed Approach: A brief explanation of how you would develop the marketing strategy and direct the campaign.

3. Specific deliverables included in the fee.  The specific services and work products included in your proposed fee.

4. Proposed project timeline and milestones.

5. Frequency of meetings, campaign reviews, and performance updates.

6. Number of creative review and revision rounds included.

7. Payment schedule and proposed milestones.

8. Any exclusions or services requiring additional compensation.

9. Availability: Your estimated professional hours and availability during the engagement.

10. Relevant Experience: Examples of previous marketing campaigns, creative direction work, and measurable results.



Long-Term Growth Opportunity

We are specifically seeking candidates who are interested in the possibility of developing a long-term professional relationship with TKS Global Solutions.

Although this opportunity begins as a project-based independent contractor engagement, our intention is to identify a marketing professional who may continue working with us through additional projects, an ongoing contractual arrangement, or potentially a full-time, in-house Marketing Director position as the company grows.



We recognize that a successful long-term relationship requires more than technical expertise.  Professional compatibility, effective communication, mutual respect, shared expectations, and the ability to work collaboratively are equally important.



The initial project will provide an opportunity for both the contractor and TKS Global Solutions to evaluate whether there is a strong professional fit.

Candidates should have a genuine interest in the possibility of continued collaboration beyond the initial assignment.



Future opportunities will depend on project performance, professional compatibility, business growth, organizational needs, and mutual agreement.



How to Apply

1. Please submit your resume or professional background, portfolio, relevant campaign examples, and proposed fixed project fee.

2. Please provide your project pricing proposal using the above guidelines.

3. In your application, please also briefly explain your interest in potentially developing a long-term working relationship with TKS Global Solutions.

4. A more detailed project description and scope of responsibilities will be provided to qualified candidates who express interest.



We look forward to reviewing your proposal.

title: Customer Support Lead – Multi-Store Fashion E-commerce | AI-First Support | Fast Growth to Head of Support
description:
Customer Support Lead – Multi-Store Fashion E-commerce | AI-First Support | Fast Growth to Head of Support





ABOUT US



MS Industries LLC runs a fast-growing group of fashion e-commerce stores (dropshipping) selling across the US, UK, Europe, and Australia. We have 4–5 stores today and plan to run 8–10 within the next 2–3 months.



We believe the profit in e-commerce is kept in the back end. Customer support is where revenue is saved, disputes are prevented, refunds stay controlled, and customers stay happy. That is why this is one of the most important roles in our company.



We're building a core team: Customer Support Lead, Dispute Manager, and Supply Chain Manager, working closely with the founder. We meet weekly as a team and work together daily through Slack. We want people to grow with us for the long term, including into future businesses.





THE ROLE



We currently have a support rep handling tickets and are hiring a Support Lead to take over and raise the standard. You'll start by owning all customer support yourself. As volume grows, you'll help hire, train, and lead new agents. Depending on how fast the stores scale, that could happen within weeks.



Current volume: 25–30 tickets/day. We expect 300–400/day during Black Friday and peak season.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- All customer support across every store: order tracking, shipping delays, returns, exchanges, refunds, and quality complaints.



- Fast response times: under 16–18 hours now, under 8–10 hours during Q4 (Gets easier once we have more CS positions working around the clock and transition to our AI ticket response platform)



- AI-first workflow: we're moving from Re:amaze to an AI support platform soon while just finalizing . For now with Re;amaze the process is the same as usual when replying to tickets - Once we have the AI platform in action, you'll review, edit, approve, and send AI-drafted replies quickly and accurately. Translation tools handle French, Spanish, and other languages.



- Preventing disputes before they happen. You won't file dispute responses; our Dispute Manager does that. But most chargebacks start in customer service, so you'll spot the customers likely to file and resolve things first with the right reply, offer, or refund.



- Refund decisions: you'll have real freedom to approve refunds and returns using good judgment, while keeping the monthly refund rate under 7%. You'll know when a full refund prevents a bigger problem and when it isn't needed.



- After-sales supplier communication about order issues, delays, and defects, working closely with our Supplier as well as our Supply Chain Manager.



- Your own tracking sheet: refunds, returns, issue reasons, order numbers, products with repeated complaints, offers made, and which reply approaches are working.



- Reporting in Slack and on weekly team calls: product quality trends, tracking issues, and recommended fixes.

- Building and improving SOPs, reply templates, and AI response guidelines as we add stores.





KPIs YOU'LL BE MEASURED ON



- Response time (targets above)

- Dispute rate trending down

- Refund rate under 7%

- Customer satisfaction and no missed tickets





PAY AND GROWTH



- $4–7 USD/hour depending on experience, full-time



- KPI bonuses paid monthly, with significantly higher earning potential during Black Friday and Q4



- Clear path to Head of Customer Support as well as possibly bigger roles with us paying over 4-5 figures USD per month, depending on how commited you are to growing at MS INDUSTRIES - with raises as you take on hiring, training, and managing a team





WHY WE REQUIRE EXPERIENCE



We're hiring heading into Black Friday, our busiest season of the year. There's no time to teach the basics of customer support right now. We need someone who can learn our systems and step in fast. We'll walk you through our stores, tools, and processes, but you should already know how to handle tickets, angry customers, refunds, and shipping issues. If you need training on the fundamentals, this isn't the right time or role.





REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of e-commerce customer support experience

- Dropshipping or multi-store support experience strongly preferred

- Strong written English and calm handling of angry customers

- Comfortable with, and excited about, AI support tools

- Experience with Shopify and a helpdesk such as Re:amaze, Gorgias, or Zendesk

- Proactive: you track your own work, spot problems early, and bring solutions

- Available to start this week and fully available through Black Friday and Cyber Monday

- Reliable internet and a backup plan for outages





WHO THRIVES HERE



- People who take action without being told and message us early when something's unclear

- People who want to learn our way of doing things, even when they have years of experience

- People who are ambitious, want to grow with the company, and treat the business like their own

- Respectful, positive communicators. Experience is valued here, ego is not.

- PEOPLE WHO ARE ACTUALLY AMBITIOUS TO GROW INTO SOMETHING* 





NOT A FIT IF YOU:



- Need reminders to answer tickets or follow up

- Prefer writing every reply from scratch over working with AI

- Want a title without taking ownership of results

- Struggle to take feedback or direction





HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this will not be reviewed)



Start your application with "I own the outcome" and answer:



1. Our dispute rate is 8.5% and our refund rate is 4%. What does that tell you about our customer support, and what would you check first?



2. In fashion e-commerce, what are the most common reasons customers open chargebacks, and how would you stop each one at the support level?



3. A customer's order has been "in transit" for 18 days. They're angry and threatening to contact their bank. Write your exact reply.



4. When would you give a full refund immediately, and when would you hold back? Give one example of each.



5. Have you used AI tools for customer support? Which ones?



6. Have you ever trained or managed other support agents?



7. Tell us about a time a manager asked you to do something differently than you would have. What did you do?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a video call interview and steps after will be clarified based on how the interview goes.

# Digital Marketing & Website Virtual Assistant

**Remote | Small Furniture Store in El Paso, Texas**



We are a small furniture store in El Paso, Texas, seeking a resourceful, organized virtual assistant to help grow our business through social media, local marketing, website improvements, and better use of business data.



We are looking for someone who can do more than publish posts. We want a proactive team member who can develop a plan, execute it consistently, measure results, and help the owner make informed decisions.



## What You’ll Do



**Manage our social media presence**



- Manage the store’s social media accounts and maintain a consistent content calendar.

- Create engaging posts, graphics, short videos, product highlights, and promotional content using photos and footage provided by our store team.

- Write clear captions and calls to action that encourage inquiries, store visits, and purchases.

- Respond to comments and messages during agreed working hours, answer approved questions, and route sales opportunities to store staff.

- Track inquiries and follow up with the store team so potential customers receive timely attention.



**Develop and execute a local marketing strategy**



- Learn about our customers, surrounding neighborhoods, competitors, and local market.

- Build a practical marketing plan for reaching furniture shoppers in the El Paso area.

- Recommend promotions, seasonal campaigns, community partnerships, and other opportunities to increase sales.

- Maintain accurate business information on Google Business Profile and other relevant listings.

- Help request and respond to customer reviews.

- Plan and manage paid social media campaigns within an owner-approved budget, if qualified.



**Improve and maintain our website**



- Review the existing website and identify outdated information, broken links, usability issues, and opportunities to improve customer inquiries.

- Update product listings, photos, prices, promotions, store hours, and contact information.

- Make routine improvements using the website’s existing platform.

- Check the mobile experience and test contact forms and links.

- Improve basic local search visibility and coordinate with a developer when advanced repairs are needed.



**Use AI and data to support better decisions**



- Use AI tools to assist with content ideas, campaign planning, research, and reporting, with human review for accuracy.

- Organize available sales, inquiry, website, and marketing data into a simple dashboard or report.

- Help identify which products, promotions, and marketing channels generate qualified inquiries and sales.

- Provide a brief weekly update explaining what happened, what we learned, and what we should try next.

- Suggest practical automations that save the owner time.

- Protect customer and business information and use only approved tools for sensitive data.



**Support related marketing projects**



- Create promotional flyers,
 campaigns, and customer follow-up templates.

- Organize product photos and marketing materials.

- Help establish a simple process for tracking leads and campaign results.

- Document recurring tasks so our marketing becomes more consistent and efficient.



## What We’re Looking For



- Experience managing social media for a business, preferably in retail, furniture, home décor, or another local business.

- Strong written English and good judgment when communicating with customers.

- Ability to create polished graphics and short videos using tools such as Canva and CapCut.

- Experience updating websites through platforms such as WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or similar systems.

- Confidence using spreadsheets and interpreting basic business and marketing metrics.

- Practical experience using AI tools, including checking their output for accuracy.

- Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to work independently.

- An updated website with accurate information and working inquiry methods.

Supply Chain & Fulfillment Manager – Multi-Store Fashion E-commerce (Dropshipping) | Supplier Management | Long-Term Role





ABOUT US



MS Industries LLC runs a fast-growing group of fashion e-commerce stores (dropshipping) selling across the US, UK, Europe, and Australia. We have 3–54stores today and plan to run 8–10 within the next 2–3 months.



We believe the profit in e-commerce is kept in the back end. Fast fulfillment, accurate tracking, and good product quality mean fewer refunds, fewer disputes, and happier customers. That makes this one of the most important roles in our company.



We're building a core team: Supply Chain Manager, Customer Support Lead, and Dispute Manager, working closely with the founder. We meet weekly as a team and work together daily through Slack. We want people to grow with us for the long term, including into future businesses.





THE ROLE



You'll own everything that happens after a customer places an order: getting it fulfilled, shipped, and tracked, and making sure what arrives matches what we sold. You'll manage our suppliers, catch problems before they turn into complaints, and keep our support and dispute teams informed.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Managing day-to-day communication with our suppliers and fulfillment agents.



- Daily product sourcing approvals (approving if a product supplier sourced is suffecient, confirming sizing details and pricing)



- Making sure orders are processed and shipped on time across all stores, and following up on anything stuck.



- Keeping tracking numbers accurate and synced to Shopify so customers always know where their order is.



- Handling supplier-side problems: delays, wrong items, defects, missing parcels, and out-of-stock products.



- Monitoring product quality and sizing complaints, and working with suppliers to fix repeat issues.



- Pushing suppliers for faster processing and shipping times and better pricing.



- Making sure suppliers can handle the volume before we scale a product, especially before Black Friday and other peak periods.



- Setting up suppliers and products as we launch new stores and enter new markets.



- Working closely with our Customer Support Lead and Dispute Manager through dedicated Slack channels (order tracking, quality complaints, and so on).



- Tracking supplier performance in your own sheet: processing times, shipping times, defect rates, and issues per product.



- Weekly reporting on fulfillment speed, problem orders, supplier performance, and recommended fixes, shared on weekly team calls.





KPIs YOU'LL BE MEASURED ON



- Order processing and delivery times

- Tracking accuracy and stuck or unfulfilled orders

- Product quality and defect complaints trending down

- Fewer refunds and disputes caused by shipping and product issues





PAY AND GROWTH



- $3-4 USD/hour depending on experience, and highly performance based - full-time (Subject to increase very fast with Q4 and performance)

- KPI bonuses paid monthly, with higher earning potential during Black Friday and Q4

- Room to grow into a bigger operations role as we scale to more stores and markets





WHY WE REQUIRE EXPERIENCE



We're hiring heading into Black Friday, our busiest season of the year. There's no time to teach the basics of dropshipping fulfillment right now. We'll walk you through our stores, suppliers, and processes, but you should already know how suppliers, agents, shipping lines, and tracking work, and how to handle problems under pressure.





REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years managing suppliers, fulfillment, or order operations for dropshipping or e-commerce

- Experience working with suppliers or sourcing agents (China-based experience preferred)

- Hands-on experience with Shopify order management and tracking

- Fashion or apparel experience strongly preferred (sizing, quality control, returns)

- Strong negotiation and follow-up skills; you don't accept "it will ship soon" as an answer

- Highly organized, with every order and issue tracked

- Strong written English

- Proactive: you spot problems early and bring solutions, not just reports

- Available to start this week and fully available through Black Friday and Cyber Monday

- Reliable internet and a backup plan for outages





WHO THRIVES HERE



- People who take action without being told and message us early when something's unclear

- People who want to learn our way of doing things, even when they have years of experience

- People who are ambitious, want to grow with the company, and treat the business like their own

- Respectful, positive communicators. Experience is valued here, ego is not.

- Experience with DayOne supplier and slack is super useful





NOT A FIT IF YOU:



- Wait for suppliers to update you instead of chasing them

- Need reminders to follow up on stuck orders

- Want a title without taking ownership of results

- Struggle to take feedback or direction





HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this will not be reviewed)



Start your application with "Profit is kept in the back end" and answer:



1. It's Black Friday week. A supplier tells you 200 orders will be delayed by 7 days. Walk us through exactly what you do in the first 24 hours.



2. How have you reduced processing or shipping times with a supplier in the past? Give specific numbers if you can.



3. We're getting repeated complaints that a top-selling product runs small and the fabric feels cheap. What do you do?



4. What suppliers, agents, and fulfillment apps have you worked with (for example CJ Dropshipping, private agents, DSers, AutoDS)?



5. How do you make sure a supplier can handle a big spike in orders before we scale a product?



6. Tell us about a time a manager asked you to do something differently than you would have. What did you do?



7. Tell us a deep indepth similar jopb experience and exactly what you did on the day to day



We are not looking for someone part time, especially with this season. We need someone dedicated, ambitous and genuinely looking to form a long lasting relationship for future businesses with us and looking to grow and learn in their personal careers.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short video interview.

title: Experienced Trades Recruiter & Practical Assessment Coordinator
description:
# Experienced Trades Recruiter & Practical Assessment Coordinator – Philippines



**Location:** Philippines, preferably Metro Manila  

**Recruiting for:** Skilled trade positions in Ireland



We are an electrical and solar installation company based in Ireland, looking for an experienced recruiter in the Philippines to work directly with us.



Our initial focus is recruiting **roofers and solar PV electricians**, with the potential to recruit additional trades as our requirements grow.



We need someone with a proven track record of recruiting skilled tradespeople who can source suitable candidates, verify their experience and organise practical assessments.



**This recruiter position is based in the Philippines. The tradespeople you recruit will be applying for positions in Ireland.**



### Your responsibilities



- Source experienced roofers and solar PV electricians interested in relocating to Ireland.

- Screen candidates against our requirements before putting them forward.

- Check qualifications, employment history, references and portfolios of completed work.

- Confirm each candidate’s actual responsibilities on previous projects.

- Assess communication skills, availability and willingness to relocate.

- Prepare clear candidate profiles with supporting evidence of experience.

- Arrange interviews and coordinate candidates for practical assessment days.

- Help organise our visit to the Philippines so we can meet shortlisted candidates and observe their skills in person.

- Maintain clear recruitment records and keep us updated on progress.



### Practical testing facilities



**Preference will be given to applicants who already have access to a suitable trade testing centre or can arrange an appropriate facility in or near Manila.**



You do not need to own a testing centre. Ideally, you will have the contacts and experience to coordinate suitable premises, equipment and qualified technical assessors.



The facility should allow candidates to demonstrate skills relevant to their roles, including:



- **Roofers:** roofing workmanship, weatherproofing, safe working practices and solar mounting installation where relevant.

- **Solar PV electricians:** installation, wiring, fault-finding, testing and commissioning of solar PV systems, inverters and battery storage.



**We will travel to the Philippines to meet shortlisted candidates and observe practical assessments in person.** We will agree the assessment requirements with you in advance.



### Essential experience and skills



- A proven track record recruiting skilled tradespeople in construction, roofing, electrical work or related sectors.

- An established network or demonstrated ability to source suitable candidates in the Philippines.

- Ability to verify practical experience through portfolios, references and supporting records.

- Strong spoken and written English.

- Strong organisational skills and clear communication.

- Ability to work directly with our team in Ireland and attend interviews and assessment days in person.



### Desirable experience



- Previous recruitment of roofers and solar PV electricians.

- Access to a suitable trade testing centre in or near Manila, or contacts to arrange one.

- Experience organising practical trade assessments and overseas employer visits.

- Experience recruiting Filipino tradespeople for overseas positions.

- Familiarity with visa and employment permit processes for Filipino workers relocating to Ireland, including coordinating documentation with employers, candidates and relevant authorised providers.

- Familiarity with Philippine overseas recruitment requirements.



### Quality expectations



We are looking for candidates with proven practical ability and a portfolio of completed work.



**Solar PV electricians must have experience independently testing and commissioning solar installations. This is essential.**



Candidates’ practical work will be thoroughly inspected and assessed against our requirements for safety, workmanship and performance. You must be able to identify suitable tradespeople and support their claimed experience with evidence.



### How to apply



Please send your CV and answer the following:



1. Which trades have you recruited, and for how long?

2. Have you recruited roofers or solar PV electricians? Please provide specific examples.

3. How do you source candidates and verify their qualifications, experience and quality of work?

4. Do you have access to a trade testing centre? If so, provide its location, available facilities and your relationship with the centre.

5. If you do not currently have access to a centre, could you arrange a suitable venue for practical assessments? Explain how.

6. Have you organised employer visits or practical trade assessments before?

7. Do you have experience coordinating visas, employment permits or overseas recruitment documentation? Describe your role and any external providers involved.

8. Where are you based, and can you attend interviews and assessment days in Manila?

9. What is your availability and proposed fee or rate?



Please include examples of previous recruitment assignments and references where available.



**Application subject: Trades Recruiter – Philippines / Ireland**

title: Virtual medical receptionist
description:
About the position



As a private dermatology practice in New York, we are seeking a dependable, personable, and organized virtual assistant to support our office’s telephone communications and daily administrative workflow.



We are looking for someone who makes patients feel welcome and heard while keeping a busy phone operation running efficiently. You should be comfortable handling a high volume of calls, managing competing priorities, and communicating clearly with patients and office staff. A warm phone manner, sound judgment, and the ability to remain calm under pressure are essential.



Schedule



This is a full-time position, 40 hours per week. The current schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. Hours are subject to change based on the practice’s needs. You must be available during the scheduled hours and follow New York local time, including daylight saving time changes.



Responsibilities



* Answer incoming calls and return patient calls. Provide friendly, professional assistance; address routine administrative questions; and help with appointment scheduling and changes according to office policies.

* Organize and route patient messages. Gather necessary information, document messages accurately, and prioritize and escalate concerns according to established office protocols. Medical questions and urgent clinical concerns must be directed to the appropriate clinical staff—not answered independently.

* Communicate closely with the physician and office staff. Relay information promptly, coordinate follow-up, track outstanding requests, and help prevent missed messages or unfinished callbacks.

* Manage a busy telephone workflow while protecting patient privacy. Move efficiently between calls, messages, and administrative tasks without sacrificing accuracy, courtesy, or confidentiality.



What we are looking for



* Excellent spoken and written English and strong interpersonal skills. A warm, friendly, patient telephone manner, clear communication, and careful listening are essential.

* Composure and good judgment. You must be able to handle high call volumes, shifting priorities, and frustrated or anxious callers professionally.

* Reliability and attention to detail. Consistent attendance, punctuality, accurate documentation, and follow-through are critical. You should be comfortable working independently while staying closely connected with the office team.

* Relevant experience and a suitable remote workspace. Experience in a U.S. medical office, medical virtual assistant position, or high-volume telephone customer service role is strongly preferred. You will need reliable internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a quiet, private workspace.



Experience with dermatology or Modernizing Medicine EMA is a plus. You must be willing to learn our systems and complete required privacy and security training.



How to apply



Please submit your résumé, a brief description of your relevant experience, and a 30–60-second voice recording introducing yourself. Include your experience handling busy phone lines, your desired hourly rate, and confirmation that you can consistently work the stated U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

title: Solar PV Electrician

### The role



- Install and connect solar PV systems on domestic and commercial properties.

- Install inverters, battery storage systems and associated electrical equipment.

- Carry out electrical wiring, testing, fault-finding and commissioning.

- Read electrical drawings and follow installation specifications.

- Work safely at heights and alongside other members of the installation team.

- Record completed work using a phone or job management app.



### What we are looking for



- A recognised electrical qualification in your country.

- Proven practical experience installing solar PV systems.

- Experience with inverters, battery storage and electrical fault-finding.

- **Experience testing and commissioning solar PV installations is essential. Applicants must be able to carry out this work independently.**

- A proven portfolio of completed solar installations that demonstrates your experience and the quality of your work.

- A good standard of spoken and written English.

- A full driving licence.

- A careful approach to safety and pride in the quality of your work.

- Willingness to relocate to Ireland for a full-time position.



**All of your work will be thoroughly inspected and assessed against the highest standards of safety, workmanship and performance. Only apply if you have a proven portfolio of solar installations and can demonstrate your ability to install, test and commission systems to these standards.**



### How to apply



Please send your CV and include:



1. Your electrical qualifications and relevant training certificates.

2. Your years of electrical experience and solar installation experience.
