title: Marketing Ops Manager —GoHighLevel & Agency Experience Required
description:
We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency working primarily with bridal and retail businesses across the USA and Canada.



We are looking for a **Marketing Operations Manager** to take ownership of the systems, processes and service delivery behind our client accounts.



This is **not a general VA role** and it is **not a traditional Account Manager role**.



We need someone who sees a broken process, investigates why it broke, fixes it, improves the system and makes sure the problem does not keep happening.



You should naturally think:



**What broke? Why did it break? Who owns the fix? When will it be fixed? Has it actually been tested? How do we stop it happening again?**



What You Will Own



You will work across our client service, advertising, creative and appointment-setting teams to make sure delivery runs properly.



Your responsibilities will include:



- identifying operational problems and bottlenecks

- troubleshooting GoHighLevel pipelines, workflows and automations

- improving handoffs between departments

- creating and improving SOPs

- assigning clear ownership and deadlines

- following up until issues are fully resolved

- verifying that fixes actually work

- improving client onboarding and service delivery

- monitoring recurring operational problems

- managing internal issue and complaint trackers

- making sure client requests do not get forgotten or left unfinished

- investigating drops in leads, appointments or conversions

- helping identify leaks across ads, landing pages, CRM, lead follow-up and appointment setting

- coordinating fixes with the correct team members

- improving accountability across the team

- reporting recurring operational risks and service-delivery issues to management



GoHighLevel Experience



Strong GoHighLevel experience is important.



You should be comfortable with:



- pipelines

- workflows

- automations

- triggers

- lead management

- forms

- calendars

- funnels

- booking systems

- speed-to-lead processes

- troubleshooting broken workflows

- identifying where leads or data are getting stuck



You do not need to personally build every technical solution, but you must understand GoHighLevel well enough to diagnose problems and coordinate the correct fix.



Digital Marketing Knowledge



You do not need to be an expert media buyer.



However, you should understand how the full customer journey works:



**Ads → Landing Page → CRM → Lead Follow-Up → Appointment → Show → Sale**



You should be comfortable reviewing things such as:



- CPL

- CTR

- CPM

- landing-page conversion rate

- lead response time

- contact rate

- appointment volume

- show rate

- lead quality

- sales conversion



When a client says, **“Appointments are down,”** we do not want someone who immediately blames the ads, the leads or one department.



We want someone who investigates the full funnel and finds the actual problem.



 AI & Automation Experience



AI and automation experience is a strong advantage.



Experience with tools such as:



- ChatGPT

- Claude

- Zapier

- Make

- GoHighLevel AI

- AI agents

- automated reporting

- automated QA

- workflow automation



is highly valuable.



We are particularly interested in people who have used AI or automation to:



- reduce repetitive admin

- improve lead handling

- improve QA

- automate reporting

- identify operational problems

- reduce human error

- maintain SOPs

- automate CRM tasks

- improve team productivity



However, **operational ownership comes first**.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to build automations. We need someone who understands why the business process exists and how to make it more reliable.



The Type of Person We Want



You should be:



- highly process-oriented

- proactive

- strong at troubleshooting

- detail-focused

- comfortable taking ownership

- comfortable holding people accountable

- good at identifying root causes

- strong with written communication

- comfortable coordinating multiple departments

- someone who follows through until an issue is genuinely resolved



We do not want someone who simply reports problems upward.



We want someone who says:



**“I found the issue, this is why it happened, this is the fix, this is who owns it, this is the deadline, and this is how we stop it happening again.”**



Experience We Value



Experience in any of the following is highly relevant:



- digital marketing agencies

- performance marketing agencies

- lead-generation agencies

- CRM / automation agencies

- client service-delivery environments



Experience coordinating people such as:



- account managers

- media buyers

- creatives

- developers

- appointment setters

- VAs

- automation specialists



is a strong advantage.



Working Hours



This is a **full-time position working 9:00 AM–6:00 PM GMT, Monday to Friday**.



You must be fully available and working during these hours.



This is **not a flexible-hours role**.



You will be coordinating with team members, reviewing active client delivery and resolving operational issues during the working day.



We are looking for someone who can make this position their **primary full-time professional commitment**.



Compensation



**US$1,350–US$1,700 per month, depending on experience and capability.**



We are willing to pay toward the top of the range for someone with strong:



- operational ownership

- digital agency experience

- GoHighLevel knowledge

- troubleshooting ability

- process improvement experience

- AI / automation capability



This is intended to be a **long-term, full-time position**.



 Important



We are looking for someone who wants to become deeply involved in improving our internal operations and service delivery.



If you are currently running your own **competing marketing agency, automation agency, consultancy or similar client-service business**, this role is unlikely to be a fit.



How to Apply



Please do **not** send a generic application message.



We have a dedicated application form that includes detailed experience questions and a short video requirement.



Apply here:







We are less interested in impressive job titles and more interested in seeing **how you think, diagnose problems, improve systems and take ownership**.

title: Voice AI & Automation Specialist
description:
Be Part of the AI Wave 



Are you passionate about building AI agents and automations that solve real-world problems?



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗨𝘀:



Hi, I'm Harry, founder of AddSomeAI, a UK-based AI and automation development firm. We work directly with business owners to identify opportunities and build tailored solutions that drive growth.



We're looking for someone to help us build AI voice agents and business automations for our clients. Both are equally important parts of this role, with an immediate telephone-based voice AI project ready to start.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲:



You'll work directly with me to build practical AI solutions, from voice agents that can hold conversations and take action to automations that connect business systems and eliminate repetitive work.



Our immediate project involves developing a telephone-based voice AI agent using LiveKit. Experience with LiveKit would be great, but we know it's a specialised framework. If you've built voice agents using Retell, Vapi or ElevenLabs, your experience could be highly transferable.



We're looking for someone who can build and troubleshoot independently, understands how to connect AI agents to real business systems, and is excited to experiment with the latest developments in voice AI.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗲 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴:



• Telephone AI Agents: Building conversational agents that can handle calls, follow instructions and complete useful tasks.



• AI Integrations: Connecting agents to APIs, CRMs, calendars, booking systems and other business software so they can retrieve information and take action.



• Business Automations: Creating workflows that connect applications, process information and reduce repetitive manual work using tools such as n8n, Make or custom code.



• Intelligent Workflows: Combining LLMs, prompting, tools and structured logic to create useful, reliable solutions for our clients.



𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:



• Build and refine voice AI agents using platforms such as Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs or LiveKit.



• Integrate voice agents with APIs, CRMs, booking systems, calendars and other business applications.



• Develop automations using n8n, Make or similar platforms, alongside custom code where needed.



• Write and refine prompts, conversation flows and tool instructions to improve agent behaviour and reliability.



• Troubleshoot issues, test real-world scenarios and ensure solutions work reliably beyond a basic demonstration.



• Keep up with the latest developments in voice AI, experiment with new tools and identify opportunities to improve what we build.



𝗘𝘀𝘀𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀:



• Practical experience building AI voice agents using dedicated voice AI platforms.



• Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make or equivalent tools.



• Experience integrating AI agents with APIs, CRMs, calendars, booking systems or other business software.



• A good understanding of LLMs, prompting, tool calling and how AI agents interact with external systems.



• The ability to troubleshoot technical problems, work independently and deliver working solutions.



• Familiarity with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or similar development technologies.



We value practical ability over qualifications. You don't need to know every tool we use, but you should be able to demonstrate what you've built and explain how it works.



𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁: 𝗚𝗼𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗟𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲



We know many people are building voice AI solutions using GoHighLevel, and experience with it is welcome. However, GoHighLevel experience alone is not sufficient for this role.



We're looking for someone who has built voice agents using dedicated voice AI platforms such as Retell, Vapi or ElevenLabs, with experience integrating them with external systems such as CRMs, booking systems, calendars and APIs.



If your experience is limited to configuring GoHighLevel's built-in voice AI features, this role probably won't be the right fit. We need someone who understands how to build, integrate and troubleshoot voice AI solutions beyond a single platform.



𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀:



• Experience with LiveKit Agents.



• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.



• Experience with 
v or Modal for running background tasks, jobs or compute workloads.



These are nice-to-haves, not requirements. We're happy to help you get up to speed with our preferred tools.



𝗞𝗲𝗲𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗨𝗽 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗟𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝗔𝗜:



Voice AI is evolving incredibly quickly, and we want someone who is genuinely excited by that.



We're happy to share training materials, resources and guidance on effective prompting, voice AI development and the latest tools and techniques. You'll have the opportunity to learn directly from our experience and work with cutting-edge technologies as we develop real solutions.



In return, we want someone who takes initiative: keeping up with industry news, testing new voice AI applications as they emerge, experimenting with new approaches and bringing ideas to the table.



You don't need to know everything already, but you should be enthusiastic about learning and actively improving your skills.



𝗣𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀:



• Problem Solver: You enjoy working through technical challenges and finding out why things aren't working.



• Self-Starter: You can research, experiment and make progress without constant supervision.



• Curious: You're excited by AI, keep up with new developments and enjoy trying new technologies.



• Pragmatic: You focus on solutions that work reliably in the real world.



• Reliable: You communicate clearly, manage your workload and deliver against agreed deadlines.



We want people who care about their work, take ownership and want to help build something worthwhile. You'll work directly with me, have the freedom to suggest improvements and see the impact of the solutions you create.



We think big, grow together and celebrate wins.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆:



The role starts as flexible, freelance, project-based work given thats how the majority of our work comes in as. We do have an immediate opportunity to contribute to a Livekit telephone-based voice AI project we expect will be 4-5 weeks of work and by that time may have other work available for you.



We'll agree the scope, fee, deliverables and deadlines before each project begins. As our client work grows, there will likely be many more opportunities for further projects and a longer-term working relationship. We expect the majority of these will be automation opportunities and hope to offer full time roles when some large contracts we have get signed off. 



Initial project: Telephone-based voice AI agent using LiveKit.



Expected start: As soon as possible



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆:



If you'd like to be considered for the role, please submit your application along with a covering letter.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗔𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀:

• The next stage will involve answering a few short questions to help us better understand your experience, technical abilities and suitability for the role.



• Successful candidates may be invited to a further discussion or a small practical assessment.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: YouTube Channel Manager, Video Editor & Animator — Christian Ministry**
description:
**Compensation:** Please include your expected hourly or monthly rate.



**About the Role**



I am a Christian minister seeking a creative, reliable person to help manage and grow my YouTube channel.



I livestream Bible teachings weekly and want someone who can turn these recordings into polished YouTube videos, engaging Shorts, and animated teaching videos. You will also upload and schedule content, create thumbnails, optimize videos, and help develop a consistent strategy for reaching more viewers.



My teachings focus on faith, prayer, identity in Christ, spiritual growth, and encouragement, primarily for an adult female audience.



**Key Responsibilities**



**1. Edit Weekly Teachings**



- Review weekly livestream recordings and edit them into polished teaching videos.

- Remove unnecessary pauses, technical interruptions, and repetition while preserving the message and natural delivery.

- Improve audio quality and add appropriate branding, captions, Scripture references, and key teaching points.

- Identify sections that could become separate videos or shorter teachings.



**2. Create YouTube Shorts**



- Select compelling moments from each teaching and turn them into engaging vertical videos.

- Add strong opening hooks, accurate captions, and suitable visuals.

- Ensure each Short communicates a clear message and encourages viewers to explore the full teaching.

- Recommend a realistic weekly publishing schedule.



**3. Produce Animated Teaching Videos**



- Adapt selected sermons into animated teaching scripts for my approval.

- Develop storyboards and create visuals that explain the teaching clearly.

- Use simple, elegant 2D animation, silhouettes, or expressive stick-figure storytelling suitable for adults.

- Synchronize animation with my recorded voice or approved narration.

- Include accurate Scripture chapter and verse references.



**4. Manage and Optimize the YouTube Channel**



- Upload, format, and schedule approved videos and Shorts.

- Create compelling thumbnails and accurate, engaging video titles.

- Write descriptions, add relevant keywords and hashtags, and organize playlists.

- Add chapters, end screens, cards, and links where appropriate.

- Maintain a content calendar around weekly teachings and ministry priorities.

- Monitor comments, respond within agreed guidelines, and flag questions requiring my response.

- Keep the channel’s branding and presentation consistent.



**5. Support Channel Growth**



- Develop practical ideas to attract the right audience and encourage repeat viewing.

- Review YouTube Analytics, including audience retention, thumbnail click-through rates, watch time, and subscriber growth.

- Provide a brief monthly report explaining what is working and what should improve.

- Test different titles, thumbnails, formats, and publishing approaches.

- Focus on authentic audience growth and meaningful engagement. Purchased subscribers, views, or engagement are prohibited.



**Skills and Experience**



- Demonstrated experience managing YouTube channels and improving their performance.

- Strong long-form video editing and short-form storytelling skills.

- Experience creating thumbnails and optimizing YouTube content.

- Ability to produce 2D animation or coordinate animation production. Please clearly state which work you complete yourself and whether you would involve anyone else.

Who We Are

Stay persistent, meet goals, and communicate obstacles early.

Collaborate effectively with the U.S. team and represent FTG with professionalism and care.



What You Bring



* Five or more years of professional recruiting experience, including experience supporting a U.S.-based staffing agency.

Experience recruiting accounting, finance, or other professional-level talent.

* A demonstrated record of meeting recruiting goals and making successful placements.

* Excellent spoken and written English, our primary language for candidate interviews and team communication.

description:
Job Title: Full-Time SMS Sales & Pipeline Specialist (GoHighLevel) – US Auto Detailing Company



About Us

AutoGlow Detailing is a high-end auto detailing and protection shop in Loveland, Colorado (USA). Our main services are full detailing, ceramic coatings, window tint, and our Unlimited Signature Club membership. We have hundreds of 5-star reviews and a growing team. We’re building systems so the business runs smoothly, and this role is a big part of that.



About the Role

You’ll own our text-based sales pipeline. Every lead that comes in gets worked by you, moved to the right stage, and followed up until they book, say no, or get handed off to our sales team. This is a sales role, not just admin. You won’t just reply to messages. You’ll build value, learn what the customer actually needs, and move them toward booking. You’ll also help us build and improve our GoHighLevel automations.



What You’ll Do



Sell our core services by text: detailing, ceramic coatings, window tint, and Signature Club memberships.

Hand off paint protection film (PPF) inquiries to our in-shop sales rep for a phone call. PPF is a premium, high-ticket service that needs a deeper conversation.

Text new and existing leads using our sales process. Ask questions, understand their vehicle and goals, build value, and earn the booking.

Quote prices only after building real value and confirming the customer intends to buy. No price-dumping.

Book appointments and take deposits using our booking system (we’ll train you).

Move every lead through the GHL pipeline accurately, with correct stages and tags, so we can track ad performance (ROAS) correctly. Every lead, every time.

Hand off high-value or complex opportunities to our in-shop sales rep for a phone call. These are the leads that won’t close easily over text.

Send weekly follow-up texts to leads in pending pipeline stages.

Run reactivation campaigns to past customers and old leads to get them back on the schedule.

Write and send weekly SMS blasts to old leads and weekly
 blasts.

Work with the team on holiday campaigns, gift card promotions, and seasonal offers.

Learn GoHighLevel deeply and help build longer automations, such as nurture sequences for leads who don’t book.

Keep opt-out and Do Not Disturb lists clean, and follow SMS compliance rules.

Report weekly results: replies, bookings, revenue booked, and reactivations.



What We’re Looking For



Strong written English. Texts must sound natural, friendly, and American, not robotic.

Sales experience, ideally text or chat sales for a US business.

GoHighLevel experience is a big plus. If you don’t have it, you must be willing to learn quickly.

Organized and detail-oriented. Pipeline accuracy matters a lot to us.

Confident handling objections like “I found it cheaper elsewhere” without immediately discounting.

Reliable internet and a quiet workspace.

Bonus: experience in automotive, home services, or local service businesses.



Schedule & Pay



Full-time, 40 hours/week

Hours overlap with US Mountain Time business hours (Mon–Fri)

$3.50/hour

Paid every 2 weeks on Fridays

Time tracked through Homebase

Performance bonus: $200 every time you reactivate past customers or old leads and book $5,000 in sales



How to Apply

To show you read this listing, start your application with the words “Glow Pipeline.”



Then reply to these 3 customer texts as if you work for us:



“How much for ceramic coating on my truck?”

“I got a quote from another shop for way cheaper. Why are you guys so expensive?”

“Hey, I came in for a detail like 6 months ago. Do you have anything going on right now?”



Also tell us:



Your sales experience (what you sold, and how: text, chat, or phone)

Your GoHighLevel experience, if any (what you built or used)

When you can start



Applications without the 3 text replies will not be considered.

title: Senior Scheduling Care Coordinator (US Home Care, US Eastern Hours)
description:
We are a growing US home care company (7 offices, about 500 caregivers) hiring an experienced, full-time Senior Scheduling Care Coordinator. This is not an entry-level role. You keep every client staffed with the right caregiver for every authorized hour. Most of the day is phone, text and our scheduling system (WellSky): a caregiver calls off at 6am, a client comes home from the hospital with new hours, a family wants a different caregiver. You fix it, document it, and make sure our field care coordinator knows. Long-term role.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain client schedules in WellSky against the plan of care, authorized hours and client preferences

- Fill open shifts and call-offs fast, before they become missed visits; look ahead and fix next week's gaps early

- Update schedules for hospitalizations, discharges and hour changes; tell caregivers and families what changed

- Match caregivers to clients by skills, availability, distance and fit; brief caregivers before first shifts and follow up after

- Work the team's task queue (timesheets, care logs, coverage) to close, same day

- Make sure scheduled hours match payer authorizations so billing is clean

- Answer caregivers, families and case managers by phone and text

- Take a turn on the after-hours on-call rotation



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of US scheduling in home care, home health or healthcare staffing (general call center or VA work does not count)

- Experience scheduling against payer authorizations (Medicaid waiver, VA, long-term care insurance)

- Excellent spoken and written English; you are the voice our clients and caregivers hear

- Able to work full US Eastern business hours, 8:30am-5:00pm ET (night shift in the Philippines)

- Calm when three things break at once, and you close every open item

- Stable internet, backup power or internet, a quiet private workspace and a headset



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- WellSky/ClearCare, AxisCare, AlayaCare, HHAeXchange or similar home care software

- RingCentral or similar phone system



The selected candidate will sign a confidentiality agreement, since the role works with client health information.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed)

1. Complete our short Culture Index survey here: 

2. Send a message here with the word "COVERED" as the first line and a short summary of your US home care or healthcare scheduling experience and the scheduling software you have used.

Finalists will complete a short paid scheduling exercise and a video interview.

title: STR Guest Experience & Operations Lead
description:
We are hiring an STR Guest Experience & Operations Lead for a BPO company supporting Airbnb and short-term rental operations.

This is a hands-on role with leadership expectations.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage guest communication before, during, and after stays.

• Resolve guest complaints, maintenance issues, cleaning concerns, and booking problems.

• Handle Airbnb Support cases, including documentation, follow-ups, and escalations.

• Manage review responses and assess potential review disputes against applicable Airbnb policies.

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance providers, and internal team members.

• Maintain clear records, shift handoffs, and client updates.

• Identify recurring problems and improve processes without waiting to be asked.

• Make decisions within established authority and escalate issues with a recommended solution.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Strong written and spoken English, with calm, professional communication.

• Evidence of initiative, accountability, and independent problem-solving.

• The ability to prioritize competing issues across multiple properties.

• Leadership experience or clear examples of guiding others and improving team performance.



Experience with property management systems such as Hostaway, Hospitable, or similar platforms is an advantage. Experience working directly for Airbnb or an Airbnb support provider is particularly valuable; please identify this clearly in your application.



MANDATORY APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Submit your résumé and a link to a 4–6 minute Loom video answering these three questions:



1. YOUR AIRBNB EXPERIENCE

How many listings have you personally supported simultaneously? Describe one Airbnb Support case involving a review, refund, cancellation, or claim that you personally handled. What did you do, what policy or evidence mattered, and what was the outcome?



2. YOUR JUDGMENT

It is 9 p.m. A guest sends photos of an inadequately cleaned apartment, demands a full refund, and says they will leave a negative review. The cleaner is not answering, your manager is unavailable, and another unit may be available.



Walk us through your first 15 minutes. What would you say to the guest? What would you verify? What could you d
 within your authority, and what would require escalation? Would you assume the review could be removed? Explain your reasoning and how you would verify the relevant policy.



3. YOUR INITIATIVE

Describe a recurring operational problem you noticed and improved without being asked. Explain what you changed and how you knew it worked.



Speak naturally and use specific examples from your own experience. Do not disclose confidential guest information or former employers’ account details.



Begin your application subject line with:

STR Lead | [Your Name] | [Maximum Listings Supported]



In your written application, also include:

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Virtual Assistant
description:

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to use Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, and Boxem to find profitable opportunities while avoiding restricted products, excessive competition, and risky listings.



We are interested in building a long-term working relationship with someone who is motivated, organized, and capable of finding quality leads consistently.



This position has the opportunity to become full time for the candidate who is highly motivated. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Product Research & Sourcing



Find profitable online arbitrage opportunities from reputable U.S. retailers.



Identify products that can be purchased at a lower price and resold on Amazon for a profit.



Research clearance sales, promotions, discounts, and other sourcing opportunities.



Provide exact Amazon ASINs and direct retailer purchase links.



Prioritize products with consistent sales history and healthy demand.



Please put any number in the subject line of your application. 

Also, please add any sourcing strategies or websites you have used to source products 



2. Product Analysis Using Keepa



Analyze historical pricing and sales rank trends.



Identify products with stable pricing and consistent sales.



Look for products with approximately 3–15 competing sellers.



Avoid listings where Amazon regularly competes for the Buy Box.



Identify products with reasonable competition and low risk of price drops.



3. SellerAmp SAS & Boxem Research



Use SellerAmp SAS to calculate estimated profit and ROI.



Research seller competition, Buy Box pricing, and product eligibility.



Use Boxem to assist with product research and restriction screening.



Prioritize products that our Amazon seller account is approved to sell.



Flag restricted brands, gated categories, and products requiring additional approval.



Avoid products with significant intellectual property complaints or other listing risks.



4. Profitability Requirements



Our preferred product criteria are:



Minimum estimated net profit: $5 per unit



Minimum estimated ROI: 30%



Seller competition: 3–15 sellers



Amazon should never be on the listing.



Consistent sales and stable pricing history.



Low risk of restrictions, counterfeit concerns, or IP complaints.



Products suitable for Amazon FBA or FBM.



5. Lead Tracking & Reporting



Maintain a detailed Google Sheet containing:



Product name



Amazon ASIN



Amazon listing URL



Retailer name and direct purchase URL



Purchase cost



Current Amazon selling price



Estimated Amazon fees



Estimated net profit



Estimated ROI



Number of competing sellers



Estimated monthly sales



Keepa pricing history observations



SellerAmp eligibility status



Boxem restriction screening results



Additional notes or potential risks



All leads must be accurate, current, and checked for duplicate submissions.



Required Qualifications



2-3 years Experience with Amazon Online Arbitrage product sourcing.



Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp SAS.



Familiarity with Boxem is a plus.



Ability to interpret Amazon sales data and pricing history.



Understanding of Amazon FBA and FBM fees.



Knowledge of Amazon selling restrictions and brand gating.



Strong attention to detail.



Excellent organizational and communication skills.



Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



2-5 buyable leads a day, that aren't shared with anyone else. It will be tracked and if found to have shared with other sellers, we will report you to onlinejobs.ph and you will not be able to apply for other jobs.

Pay: $400 - $700 per month (depending on experience & output)

Job Type: Part-time — 4 hours/day, 5 days/week (with fast-track to full-time)

Work Location: Remote



YOUR WORK WILL INVOLVE

- Compositing products into real-world and lifestyle environments

- Advanced retouching, color correction, and cleanup

- Matching lighting, shadows, and textures for realistic integration

- Designing clean, modern marketing graphics and layouts

- Working with basic 3D assets or renders when needed

- Preparing polished assets for social, web, and digital campaigns



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Edit and composite images to achieve photorealistic results

- Apply advanced Photoshop techniques to adjust lighting, shadows, and textures

- Design visually cohesive assets aligned with brand guidelines

- Collaborate with the creative team on campaign visuals

- Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables



QUALIFICATIONS

- Expert-level Adobe Photoshop skills (compositing, blending, lighting)

- Strong graphic design fundamentals (layout, typography, hierarchy)

- Experience with lifestyle, product, or advertising imagery

- Basic understanding of 3D renders and how they integrate into Photoshop

- Ability to work efficiently without sacrificing quality



AI & WORKFLOW (IMPORTANT)

We actively use AI as part of our creative workflow, but never as a replacement for craft or taste. Any AI experience is welcome, but not required. While working with us, you will be taught specific, high-level ways to integrate AI into your workflow that enhance realism, speed, and creative control, without producing generic or over-automated results. Our approach focuses on:

- Combining traditional Photoshop and design skills with AI tools

- Avoiding "AI slop" or one-click outputs

- Using AI to support craftsmanship, not replace it

These are top-of-market workflows you'll gain hands-on experience with and carry forward into your career.



GROWTH & OPPORTUNITY

This is a part-time role with significant growth potential. Team members who consistently deliver high-quality work and integrate well into our workflow are fast-tracked for full-time opportunities as the team and workload expand.



PREFERRED SKILLS

- Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator and InDesign

- Experience working with brand guidelines

- Knowledge of color grading and post-production workflows

- Any prior experience using AI tools in creative workflows

title: Node.js Developer (Full-Time): Keep Our Live Systems Running
description:
We’re a small, profitable media company. We run our YouTube production through our own web portal (research, an AI video editor, copyright checks, translation, task tracking), and we’re building a second product next to it. Both are large, mostly AI-built, and live in production. We need an engineer who keeps them healthy, checks what the AI writes, and helps them grow.



Hours: 40 h/week, overlapping 10:00 to 18:00 Philippine time.

Salary: USD $1,000–$1,200/month, depending on experience.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Investigate and fix bugs from Sentry and from the team, prioritizing urgent issues during your hours.

- Write tests and help keep our production systems reliable.

- Build small features from written specs as tested, reviewed PRs.

- First project: write the architecture and setup docs.



Initially, you’ll focus on bug fixes, tests, documentation, and small features. The founder retains deployment decisions and provides backup for production i
. Your ownership will grow as you learn the systems and demonstrate reliable delivery.



STACK



- Node.js 20 (Express, ES modules), PostgreSQL, plain HTML/JS plus a React/TypeScript editor, Docker on Railway, GitHub Actions, Sentry.

- Some Python, FFmpeg, yt-dlp.

- APIs: Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, YouTube, Trello, 
, Dropbox.



YOU HAVE



- 3+ years of Node.js in production, and solid Postgres/SQL.

- Experience debugging live systems down to the root cause.

- Experience working in a large codebase you didn’t write.

- The habit of writing tests and keeping PRs small.

- Good written English.

- Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex), and you can check their output.



Nice to have: Python, FFmpeg/video, Docker, LLM APIs.



HOW WE HIRE



1. Written application.

2. A 20-minute call.

You sign an NDA and an IP agreement, and all code goes through reviewed PRs.



TO APPLY

title: Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager |Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote
description:
Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager



Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company operating multiple Shopify stores across several countries and processing significant transaction volumes through multiple payment providers.



We are looking for a highly capable Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager to professionalize and take ownership of our finance function.



This is NOT a junior bookkeeping position.



We already have finance/accounting activities taking place inside the company. We need a senior finance professional who can ensure that our numbers are accurate, our controls are strong and management has reliable financial information for decision-making.



Your Mission



Build a finance function that the founder can trust.



You will assess our current finance processes, identify weaknesses, improve controls and reporting, and oversee the people performing recurring finance work.



Responsibilities



* Own financial reporting and financial accuracy

* Review and improve our current finance processes

* Oversee bookkeeping and accounting workflows

* Review reconciliations across banks and payment processors

* Ensure Shopify/order data reconciles correctly with financial records

* Monitor payment processor settlements and fees

* Review supplier payments and COGS

* Improve expense categorization and controls

* Monitor refunds, chargebacks and payment-related losses

* Produce reliable monthly P&L reporting

* Produce consolidated and store-level management reporting

* Develop cash-flow reporting and forecasting

* Build budgets and forecasts

* Identify unusual financial movements and discrepancies

* Establish appropriate approval and financial control processes

* Review the work of junior finance/accounting team members

* Improve month-end closing procedures

* Work with external accountants, tax advisers and other specialists where required

* Help management understand profitability and financial performance

* Identify opportunities for financial automation and better systems



E-Commerce Complexity



Experience with high-volume e-commerce is strongly preferred.



Our environment may include:



* Multiple Shopify stores

* Multiple currencies

* Multiple countries

* Stripe

* Shopify Payments

* PayPal

* Klarna and other payment methods

* Refunds

* Chargebacks

* Supplier payments

* Advertising spend

* FX

* Payment processor fees



You should be comfortable reconciling complex transaction flows rather than only traditional invoice-based businesses.



What We Are Looking For



* Strong accounting/finance foundation

* Significant experience in financial control, finance management or senior accounting

* Excellent reconciliation skills

* Strong management reporting ability

* Experience creating or improving financial controls

* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience with accounting software such as Xero or QuickBooks

* High attention to detail

* Strong analytical ability

* Ability to investigate discrepancies independently

* Ability to review and challenge the work of others

* Strong written English



CPA/ACCA/CIMA or comparable professional qualifications are highly valued but not automatically required if your experience is exceptional.



What We Are NOT Looking For



This is not suitable for someone whose experience is primarily:



* Data entry

* Basic bookkeeping

* Accounts payable only

* Virtual assistance

* Producing reports without understanding the underlying numbers



We need someone capable of owning and controlling a finance function, not simply processing transactions.



What Success Looks Like



Management can confidently answer:



* How profitable are we?

* Which stores are most profitable?

* What is our real COGS?

* Where is our cash?

* What are our payment processor balances?

* Are all transactions reconciled?

* What are our major financial risks?

* How are actual results performing against forecast?



And most importantly: management can trust the answers.



Application



Please answer:



1. What is the largest company, measured by annual revenue or transaction volume, for which you have personally managed or controlled finance?

2. Describe the most complex reconciliation environment you have worked with.

3. Have you worked with Shopify, Stripe, PayPal or similar payment processors? Explain exactly what you were responsible for.

4. Tell us about a significant financial discrepancy or control problem you personally discovered. How did you find it and what happened?

5. Which financial reports did you personally prepare or review each month?

6. Have you managed or reviewed the work of other accountants/bookkeepers? How many?

7. Which accounting qualifications do you hold?

8. Which accounting systems are you strongest with?

9. What is your current availability and expected monthly compensation for a full-time position?



Begin your application with FINANCIAL CONTROL.

title: Residential CAD Drafter / Space Planning Technician
description:
ABOUT US

We are a growing residential construction and remodeling company based in Utah, USA. We specialize in basement finishing, residential remodeling, and home improvements.



We're looking for a talented, detail-oriented CAD Drafter to join our team and take ownership of our residential drafting needs. This is a long-term position with the opportunity to grow as our company expands.



We value accuracy, thoughtful design, professional presentation, and dependable communication.



HIRING TIMELINE:

We are looking to find the right candidate as soon as presented and would potentially look to start training and onboarding this individual onto our team within the next month.



RESPONSIBILITIES



1. PRELIMINARY FLOOR PLANS & ESTIMATING



- Convert hand-drawn sketches, field measurements, and photographs from our sales team into accurate, professional 2D CAD floor plans. Bonus for creation of 3D renderings

- Prepare quantity reports including total finished square footage, flooring areas by material type, wall lengths, room counts, doors, and other estimating measurements.

- Identify potential layout concerns and recommend practical improvements to room configurations, traffic flow, and space utilization.

- Deliver completed preliminary drawings and quantity reports by 8:00 AM Utah time the following business morning.



2. CONSTRUCTION & PERMIT DRAWINGS



- Develop approved preliminary layouts into complete residential construction and permit drawing packages.

- Prepare floor plans, electrical layouts, plumbing layouts, dimensions, notes, and other required documentation using established company templates.

- Incorporate revisions and respond to straightforward permit review comments.

- Complete standard permit drawing packages within 48 hours of receiving finalized project information.



3. DRAWING STANDARDS & ORGANIZATION



- Maintain consistent drawing quality, formatting, layers, dimensions, and presentation standards.

- Organize and maintain CAD files, drawing revisions, and project documentation.

- Help develop and improve our drawing templates and drafting processes.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required:



- Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or equivalent DWG-compatible CAD software.

- Experience preparing residential architectural floor plans.

- Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and visual presentation.

- Ability to interpret hand sketches, measurements, and reference photographs.

- Ability to calculate and report accurate areas, lengths, and quantities.

- Practical understanding of residential space planning, including room layouts, doors, windows, and circulation.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Reliable internet access and ability to consistently meet deadlines.

- Ability to work independently and proactively identify missing or conflicting information.



Preferred:



- Experience preparing residential electrical and plumbing plans.

- Familiarity with U.S. residential construction drawings.

- Experience with residential remodeling or basement finishing projects.

- Familiarity with architectural drawing conventions and construction terminology.



An architecture or engineering degree is not required. We value demonstrated skill, sound judgment, and quality work over formal credentials.



SCHEDULE & WORK ARRANGEMENT



This is a salaried remote position with flexible working hours.



Our primary expectations are dependable communication, high-quality work, and consistent completion of assignments within established deadlines.



Workload may vary from week to week. We recognize that some weeks will be busier than others and offer flexibility in how work is scheduled.



Outside freelance work is permitted, provided it does not interfere with our assignments, deadlines, availability expectations, or confidentiality requirements.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work and wants to establish a long-term relationship with our company.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH

- Consistent monthly compensation regardless of fluctuations in project volume.

- Flexible remote working arrangement.

- Opportunity to help establish our company's drafting standards and processes.

- Potential to grow into a senior or lead drafting position as our company expands.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction.

2. Examples of residential floor plans or construction drawing packages you have personally prepared. Please make sure all drawings have your initials or signature. No copying of other work and no use of A.I.

3. Your experience with AutoCAD and residential drafting.

4. Your expected monthly salary.

5. A brief explanation of your experience converting hand-drawn sketches into CAD drawings.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical drafting assessment using an actual residential basement project.



We are looking for someone who appreciates that a great drawing is more than lines and dimensions. It should be accurate, clear, thoughtfully designed, and professionally presented.

title: Senior Client Accountant – Canadian Clients | PH CPA, Xero + QBO Certified | Full-Time Night Shift
description:
Own a book of Canadian small-business clients from home. USD $10-11/hour, full time and long term, on Canadian business hours (night shift in the Philippines). Work directly with our founder and grow into a team lead role.





ABOUT CAYDE



Cayde Accounting and Tax is a fast-growing, fully remote Canadian accounting and tax firm. We help owner-managed Canadian corporations get caught up on bookkeeping, corporate tax and GST/HST, and then stay caught up. Our team works across Canada and the Philippines.





THE ROLE



We need a confident, experienced accountant who can own client relationships on their own. You will run video and phone meetings with Canadian business owners, explain their numbers in plain English, and give clear guidance. Then you make sure the work behind it is done right.



This is a client-facing role first, and customer service is how we win: clients hear back from us fast, every time. If you prefer to stay behind the screen, this is not the job for you.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Own a book of clients: lead meetings by video and phone, and answer client requests by phone,
 and text the same business day

• Interpret financial statements and explain results, cash flow and tax impact to owners who are not accountants

• Handle monthly bookkeeping for your clients in Xero and QuickBooks Online: bank feeds, reconciliations, sales tax coding, month-end close and reports

• Run full catch-up bookkeeping projects, from bank feeds to year-end, with sales tax coded and reconciled correctly

• Prepare year-end files that verify each client's books are accurate and tax-ready, then coordinate with our tax preparers on T2, T1 and GST/HST/PST filings: collect what they need, track deadlines, keep clients updated

• Walk clients through finished returns and what they mean for the business

• Handle other client needs as they come up: document requests, CRA notices, onboarding, follow-ups

• Join internal team meetings and coordinate with our bookkeeping team

• Help us adopt new tools, automation and AI as we grow





MUST-HAVES



• Licensed CPA (Philippines), with PRC license number

• Xero Advisor AND QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certifications: at least one when you apply, both before your start date (both are free)

• 4+ years of accounting experience, including 2+ years serving clients in Canada, the US, Australia or the UK

• 2+ years in a client-facing role: leading meetings, interpreting financial results for business owners, and handling client questions on your own, with a track record of fast, friendly service

• Solid grasp of how sales tax works in the bookkeeping process and how business income tax is calculated (we will teach you the Canadian specifics)

• Experience preparing year-end files that verify a client's books are accurate and ready for tax preparation

• Excellent spoken and written English; confident on camera

• Full-time availability on the schedule below

• Tech-savvy: you learn new software fast and look for better ways to work





STRONG ADVANTAGE

description:

We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands and we are scaling the next ones right now. We are looking for one dedicated, long-term video editor to join us full time and own video production for our paid ads on Meta.



READ THIS FIRST



This is a senior role. We are looking for the best editors in the game, not people who are still learning.



If you are a beginner, a student, or someone who has edited a few TikToks for friends, this is not the job for you. We respect your time, so please respect ours and do not apply.



If you have been cutting direct response ads for e-commerce brands for years, you understand hooks, retention and why an ad converts, and you already work with AI video tools daily, keep reading.



WHAT WE ARE FOCUSED ON RIGHT NOW: AI DRAMA



Our main format right now is AI drama: ads built from realistic, movie-style AI scenes with real characters, real emotion and a story that pulls the viewer in and sells.



If you have experience producing AI drama ads (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Google Flow or similar), this is a huge bonus for you. Send us your AI drama work first and put it at the top of your application. Candidates with real AI drama experience will be moved to the front of the line.



Other formats you will work on:

- AI talking heads and authority figure videos

- UGC-style ads (Kling, HeyGen)

- Short-form AI animation (Google Flow)

- VSLs built from proven scripts



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Turn our proven winning scripts and messaging into finished video ads

- Deliver around 2 video batches per day, each with 3 hook variations

- Roughly 6 minutes of edited material per day (typically two videos of 2 to 3 minutes)

- Work from clear briefs and references from us, then execute at a high level with minimal hand holding

- Prompt, generate and assemble AI footage, then cut it into ads that convert

- Build and reuse a b-roll library so production gets faster over time



WHO YOU ARE



- Senior editor with real experience in e-commerce direct response video ads

- Daily hands-on experience with AI video tools, not just "I tried it once"

- You already pay for your own AI video tools and use them every day

- You understand pacing, hooks, retention and story structure for paid ads

- Fast, reliable, consistent, and you take ownership of your output

- Available full time and looking for a long-term seat, not a one-off gig

- Strong written English



THE PAID PRE-TRIAL ($150)



Before we hire anyone, shortlisted candidates complete a paid pre-trial. This is how we separate the real editors from the rest.



- We pay $150 for the pre-trial

- The task: produce one AI drama video, approximately 6 to 8 minutes long, from a brief we give you

- You use your own AI tools and your own subscriptions. We do not provide tool access for the pre-trial.

- Paid tools only. Free tiers, free trials and watermarked outputs will not be accepted and we are not taking any excuses about it.

- We expect high quality output with consistent characters, consistent scenes and clean, professional editing from start to finish

- Your pre-trial is the d
 factor. The hire comes from the pre-trial results, not from the CV.



If you are not sure you can deliver this, or you do not have paid AI tools of your own, do not apply.



THE OFFER



- Flat monthly fee: $1,500 USD

- Performance bonuses on top of the flat fee, paid every time a batch of your ads wins in the ad account. Your results are rewarded directly.

- Full access to our AI tool stack once hired

- Dedicated, long-term collaboration with a brand portfolio, not a one-brand startup



HOW TO APPLY



1. Put "AI DRAMA" as the first word of your application so we know you read this

2. Link to your portfolio of ad work, with your AI drama examples first if you have them

3. Tell us in 3 to 5 lines which paid AI video tools you use daily and which e-commerce brands or niches you have edited for

4. Confirm you are available full time and that you can complete the pre-trial with your own paid tools



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Generic copy-paste applications will be ignored.



Shortlisted candidates receive the $150 pre-trial brief, and the best editor gets hired.



One last thing: write the word BOOK as the very first word of your application, so we know you read everything.

title: Shopify Dispute & Chargeback Manager
description:
Work Schedule: Full-time | Remote | Flexible Hours (with daily reporting)



Experience Required: At least 2 years in eCommerce Dispute / Chargeback Management



About the Role



We are an international eCommerce company operating multiple Shopify-based stores. We are looking for a highly organized and analytical Dispute & Chargeback Manager who will take full ownership of handling and winning disputes across Shopify, PayPal, and credit card processors.



The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully reversing disputes, reducing chargeback ratios, and providing data-driven insights to improve customer experience and store health metrics.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage and respond to Shopify, PayPal, and card processor disputes and chargebacks within required deadlines.

- Analyze dispute trends and provide weekly and monthly reports on dispute rates, win/loss ratio, and reasons.

- Collect and organize evidence (tracking info, correspondence, invoices, etc.) to build strong dispute cases.

- Collaborate with the Customer Service and Operations teams to ensure disputes are supported by accurate records and prompt communication.

- Maintain and update a Dispute Tracker Sheet with real-time data per store.

- Identify process gaps and propose improvements to reduce dispute occurrence.

- Maintain consistent follow-ups with payment processors and gateways.

- Ensure all dispute responses meet each platform's documentation and format requirements.

- Monitor KPIs such as win rate %, dispute volume, and resolution turnaround time.



Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of experience handling Shopify and PayPal disputes / chargebacks for dropshipping or eCommerce stores.

- Strong understanding of Shopify Payments, PayPal Resolution Center, and credit card chargeback workflows (Visa/Mastercard).

- Proven track record of winning chargebacks and maintaining a low dispute ratio.

- Excellent data analysis and reporting skills (Google Sheets / Excel proficiency required).

- Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work independently under tight deadlines.

- Strong communication and documentation skills in English (written and verbal).

- Experience using CRM or ticketing systems (Re:amaze) is a plus.

- Must be organized, proactive, and metrics-driven.



Preferred Skills



- Experience working with multiple Shopify dropshipping stores.

- Familiarity with dropshipping operations, refund policies, and logistics issues.

- Knowledge of chargeback automation tools or dispute analytics dashboards.

- Basic understanding of GMC (Google Merchant Center) health metrics is a plus.



What We Offer



- $5–$6 USD per hour depending on experience.

- Long-term, stable position with room for growth.

- Performance-based bonuses for maintaining low dispute ratios and high win rates.

- Supportive, collaborative remote work environment.

- Opportunity to lead dispute management processes across multiple international brands.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



- Your updated resume (with specific experience handling disputes/chargebacks)

- A short cover letter describing your most successful dispute win and your approach to managing chargebacks

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description:
Our remote team is growing, and we need an eCommerce VA who is reliable, self-driven, and sharp with details, someone who wants a real career with us, not just a stopgap. We run the daily operations of online brands for clients around the world, and you'll support several of them at once. No two days look alike. Expect busy task lists, last-minute changes, fast turnarounds, and priorities that shift quickly. We need someone who stays organized, follows our processes, handles pressure well, and keeps quality high when things get hectic.



Role details:

- Start date: as soon as possible

- Full-time, long-term

- Graveyard shift (Philippine time), Monday to Friday

- Weekends off

- Occasionally, we may ask for extra hours for urgent client requests or deadlines. It won't be every day, but flexibility matters in our fast-paced setting.



What you'll do:

- Run and maintain Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores

- Build, edit, and optimize product listings

- Research products, competitors, and market trends

- Help with customer support and order handling

- Keep websites updated and take care of general admin

- Support our marketing and content work

- Create simple graphics and marketing visuals in Canva

- Make basic layout and design improvements to websites

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- Follow our systems, SOPs, checklists, and instructions

- Manage tasks across multiple client accounts

- Respond quickly to updates and requests during your shift

- Keep your work organized and on time during busy periods



As you prove your reliability, we'll give you more: greater independence with client accounts and bigger, higher-value projects.



Who we're looking for:

- You have hands-on Shopify experience: product listings, store updates, theme edits, and order management

- You learn fast and can figure things out on your own

- You're highly organized with a sharp eye for detail

- You own your work and take accountability for results

- You follow instructions closely and meet deadlines

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You're hardworking and proactive

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment

- You stay calm and professional with urgent requests

- You have a reliable laptop or desktop and a stable, fast internet connection

- You're fully available for the entire shift

- You have no other job, clients, business, or personal commitments that could affect your availability, focus, or performance



Bonus skills (not required):

- Experience with WooCommerce, Amazon, or TikTok Shop

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Basic video editing in CapCut

- A background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or admin work



Beyond Shopify, experience isn't everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability over years on a resume. We can teach you the other platforms and tools, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and growth:

- Monthly salary: ₱28,000 to ₱32,000

- Monthly performance incentive: up to ₱5,000, based on performance

- ₱1,500 signing bonus after completing the probationary period

- Regular salary increases based on performance

- A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

- Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

- Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why join us:

- Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

- Work within clear systems and processes

- Get proper guidance, training, and regular performance feedback

- Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop

- Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools

- Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

- Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This isn't for everyone

We're not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum. We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused, and owns the outcome. The work can get intense and priorities can change fast, so you need to be comfortable adapting and handling several responsibilities at once without letting quality drop. Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you're after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn't the right fit.



How to apply

Please send us:

- Your updated resume

- A screenshot of your internet speed test

- Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM, and storage

- A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience (especially your Shopify work), and telling us why you're the right person for this role



Important: Put "ECOMMERCE VA - (YOUR NAME)" in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One last thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We're looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity, or performance.



If you're disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Grant Writer & Funding Research Specialist — U.S. Nonprofit
description:
Future Families for Adults is seeking an organized, motivated grant writer to find funding opportunities, prepare and submit applications, and track results.



We are a brand-new nonprofit with no organizational funding yet. Helping us secure our first grants and establish a foundation for growth will be the central purpose of this role.



This position offers a supportive remote training environment with paid training. We value strong writing skills, initiative, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.



ABOUT OUR MISSION

Future Families for Adults is building a future where adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities have lasting family connections, support, and belonging—including when their parents or caregivers can no longer care for them.



Our vision includes connecting adults with adoptive families and developing Jeff’s Homes, a program focused on supportive community living, meaningful work opportunities, and social connection.



Our early work includes education, family planning, resource navigation, referrals, partnerships, and researching housing options. We need someone who can turn this vision into clear, fundable proposals.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Research grants that match our mission, location, organizational stage, and eligibility.

• Prioritize opportunities available to brand-new nonprofits without existing funding or an established grant history.

• Verify application requirements, deadlines, funding restrictions, and any matching-fund requirements.

• Review our materials and identify information or documents needed for applications.

• Prepare complete grant applications, letters of inquiry, proposals, organizational summaries, and supporting materials.

• Work with the founder to develop project budgets, realistic goals, and measurable outcomes.

• Submit applications by their deadlines.

• Track each opportunity from research through application, follow-up, and funding decision.

• Maintain organized records of submissions, confirmations, funder correspondence, and results.

• Monitor reporting requirements for awarded grants and coordinate reports with the founder.

• Provide regular progress updates and flag questions or missing information promptly.



TRAINING AND INDEPENDENT RESPONSIBILITY

• Complete paid remote training to become familiar with our mission, programs, materials, and processes.

• Work with the founder on initial applications. The founder will review the first few submissions and provide feedback.

• Once you are familiar with the organization and the founder has reviewed a few submissions, you will be expected to independently find suitable grants, prepare and submit applications, and track the results.

• Continue providing regular updates and seek approval for new commitments, budget changes, or information that requires the founder’s decision.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Excellent written English, research skills, and attention to detail.

• Strong organization, deadline management, and proactive communication.

• Ability to interpret funder guidelines and determine eligibility.

• Initiative and the ability to manage the grant application process independently after training.

• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and apply feedback.

• Ability to handle sensitive information confidentially.

• Reliable internet access and a computer suitable for remote work.

• Experience researching, writing, submitting, or tracking U.S. nonprofit grants is preferred.

• Experience securing funding for brand-new nonprofits is especially valuable.

• Experience with disability services, family support, housing, or community development is a plus.



INITIAL PRIORITIES

• Complete paid onboarding and review our mission and existing materials.

• Identify gaps in our readiness to apply for grants.

• Build a prioritized list of suitable funding opportunities.

• Establish a grant calendar and application tracker.

• Develop reusable grant language.

• Prepare initial applications for the founder’s review.

• Progress toward independently finding, applying for, and tracking grants.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

• Fully remote, part-time: 20 hours per week, including paid training.

• Starting pay: $5 USD per hour.

• Eligibility for promotion to $11 USD per hour based on available funding provided by grants. The increase is not guaranteed and requires confirmation of sufficient funding.

• Flexible scheduling, with some availability for meetings and training in U.S. Central Time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:



1. Your résumé and a brief introduction explaining your interest and relevant skills.

2. One or two existing grant-writing samples, with confidential information removed. If you do not have grant samples, provide a relevant research or persuasive writing sample.

3. A description of your grant experience, including any grants you helped secure and your specific contribution, if applicable.

4. Any experience helping brand-new nonprofits secure their first funding.

5. Your weekly availability and time zone.

6. A brief explanation of how you would find grants for a new nonprofit with no existing funding and manage applications independently after training.

7. Confirmation that you understand and accept the starting rate of $5 USD per hour for 20 hours per week, including paid training.



Please begin your application with “Future Families” so we know you read the full posting.



WAGE/SALARY

$5 USD/hour starting, including paid training; eligible for promotion to $11 USD/hour based on available grant funding.



DESIRED NUMBER OF HOURS PER WEEK

20

title: Senior Recruiter - Insurance Sales
description:
Senior Recruiter - Insurance Sales

Full-time · Fully Remote · Based in the Philippines · Direct Hire with U.S. Client



IMPORTANT: Direct experience recruiting insurance sales professionals for the U.S. market is mandatory. Applicants whose insurance recruitment experience is limited to customer service, claims, underwriting, technology, or corporate support positions will not meet this requirement and will be automatically rejected.



About the Opportunity



Alderstone Partners is representing a U.S. insurance agency seeking an experienced Senior Insurance Sales Recruiter based in the Philippines to join its team directly and support recruitment across assigned U.S. markets.



This is a full time, direct hire opportunity with the client organization. The successful candidate will be employed directly by the client, not Alderstone Partners.



We are seeking a recruiter with demonstrated experience identifying, engaging, and evaluating insurance sales professionals, with relevant exposure to independent agents, benefits counselors, account development professionals, or agency sales leaders.



The ideal candidate understands the differences between salaried insurance positions and independent agent opportunities, including how compensation expectations, prospecting responsibilities, licensing readiness, and business development requirements influence candidate suitability.



Beyond sourcing, this position requires sound candidate judgment, professional communication, and consistent follow through from initial outreach through interviews, licensing preparation, contracting, and onboarding.



What You Will Do

- Partner with agency leadership to understand hiring priorities, target territories, candidate requirements, and the structure of each opportunity.

- Source insurance sales professionals, benefits counselors, account development candidates, and sales leaders according to assigned searches.

- Identify experienced licensed professionals and candidates from other sales backgrounds where the hiring brief permits.

- Screen candidates for relevant sales experience, prospecting activity, relationship development, communication skills, and career motivation.

- Distinguish personal insurance sales production from customer service, policy administration, enrollment support, and team management responsibilities.

- Assess candidates’ understanding of independent agent opportunities, compensation arrangements, and the responsibilities of building a sales business.

- Confirm current licensing status, willingness to complete required licensing steps, location, availability, and alignment with the opportunity.

- Conduct targeted Boolean searches, competitor research, and talent mapping to identify qualified active and passive candidates.

- Engage candidates through LinkedIn,
, phone, referrals, professional networks, and other approved sourcing channels.

- Present opportunities accurately using approved information about compensation, training, licensing, and agency support.

- Coordinate interviews, prepare candidate assessments, and maintain engagement throughout the selection process.

- Follow up on licensing preparation, contracting, and onboarding milestones in coordination with agency leadership.

- Maintain accurate ATS or CRM records, screening notes, candidate submissions, and pipeline updates while protecting confidential information.

- Report search progress, candidate objections, interview attendance, and recruitment obstacles promptly.

What We Are Looking For

- Direct experience sourcing and screening insurance sales candidates for the U.S. market.

- Ability to explain the specific insurance sales positions recruited and personal involvement in successful hires.

- Understanding of the differences between independent agents, employee sales representatives, benefits counselors, and agency leaders.

- Ability to assess prospecting experience, sales responsibilities, candidate motivation, and realistic career expectations.

- Familiarity with U.S. insurance licensing processes and the importance of confirming requirements for each opportunity.

- Previous experience with insurance agencies, carriers, recruitment firms, staffing organizations, or relevant internal talent acquisition teams.

- Strong direct sourcing, Boolean search, passive candidate engagement, and relationship management skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly with U.S. candidates and hiring stakeholders.

- Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS or CRM platforms, recruiting databases, and other sourcing tools.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to manage searches independently.

- Availability to support U.S. business hours based on client requirements.

Preferred Recruitment Specializations



We are particularly interested in recruiters with experience sourcing and placing professionals within one or more of the following areas.



Insurance Sales and Business Development

- Life and Health Insurance Agents

- Independent Insurance Sales Representatives

- Employee Benefits and Voluntary Benefits Sales

- Account Opening and Business Development

Benefits Counseling and Enrollment

- Benefits Counselors

- Licensed Benefits Enrollment Professionals

- Worksite Benefits Sales and Enrollment

Agency Sales Leadership

- Agency Sales Managers

- Agency Development Managers

- District and Territory Sales Leaders

Candidates are not expected to have experience in every specialization listed. We are primarily interested in the depth of your relevant U.S. insurance sales recruitment experience, your understanding of candidate qualifications, and your ability to identify suitable professionals for specific agency requirements.



What We Value

- Market understanding: Familiarity with U.S. insurance sales careers, candidate backgrounds, licensing considerations, and agency hiring requirements.

- Candidate judgment: Assess relevant sales experience, prospecting readiness, career motivation, and alignment with the opportunity’s compensation and working structure.

- Sourcing expertise: Resourceful research and targeted outreach that reaches qualified professionals, including passive candidates.

- Professional communication: Clear, accurate conversations that establish credibility and keep candidates and hiring stakeholders informed.

- Ownership and consistency: Organized pipelines, reliable follow through, accurate documentation, and accountability for recruitment progress.

Compensation



The compensation range will be confirmed with the client before publication.



Final compensation will depend on relevant insurance sales recruitment experience, U.S. market exposure, sourcing expertise, communication skills, and overall alignment with the client’s requirements.



Employment Structure



This is a direct hire opportunity with Alderstone Partners’ client. The selected candidate will join and work directly with the client organization.



This is not a temporary staffing assignment, and the selected candidate will not be employed or payrolled by Alderstone Partners.



Alderstone Partners facilitates the search, candidate assessment, introduction, and hiring process. The client organization retains responsibility for the final hiring decision and employment arrangement.

We specialize in weddings, prom, homecoming, airport transfers, and corporate travel.

,
, Instagram, and Google Business messages, so every lead gets a fast, professional reply.

- A paid trial project first, then steady part-time work that can become full-time

- Performance bonuses tied to booking growth

- A path to a lead role as we open new markets
