title: Trustpilot Review & Online Reputation Specialist (Part-Time | Remote)
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and reliable **Trustpilot Review & Online Reputation Specialist** to join our team.



Your main responsibility is to monitor Trustpilot reviews across multiple e-commerce stores, respond to customer feedback, identify and report fake or suspicious reviews, and coordinate with our Customer Support team to resolve customer complaints.



We need someone who can work independently, take initiative, and actively help improve our stores' online reputation.



**Working Hours:** 2–3 hours per day  

**Job Type:** Part-Time | Remote  

**Schedule:** Flexible



### Key Responsibilities



- **Daily Review Monitoring:** Check all assigned Trustpilot accounts daily for new positive, neutral, and negative reviews.

- **Review Responses:** Respond professionally to customer reviews, especially negative reviews that require immediate attention.

- **Identify and Flag Fake Reviews:** Investigate suspicious, spam, misleading, or potentially fake reviews and report them through Trustpilot's official reporting system when they violate platform guidelines.

- **Review Verification:** Check available customer and order records to determine whether a review can be linked to a genuine customer experience.

- **Monitor Flagged Reviews:** Track reported reviews, follow up on Trustpilot's decisions, and document whether reviews are removed, retained, or under investigation.

- **Customer Follow-Ups:** Coordinate with the Customer Support team through Freshdesk to resolve complaints and follow up with customers when necessary.

- **Review Resolution:** Encourage customers to voluntarily update their reviews when their concerns have been resolved, without offering incentives or making assistance conditional on a review change.

- **Performance Tracking:** Maintain accurate records of reviews, customer responses, flagged reviews, resolutions, and changes in Trustpilot scores.

- **Weekly Reports:** Submit a weekly report summarizing review activity, TrustScores, complaint trends, flagged reviews, and completed tasks.

- **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring customer complaints and recommend actions to improve customer satisfaction and store reputation.



### Requirements



- Strong written English communication skills.

- Previous experience managing Trustpilot or other online review platforms is preferred.

- Familiarity with Freshdesk, Shopify, or similar customer service platforms is an advantage.

- Ability to identify suspicious reviews and understand Trustpilot's reporting guidelines.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to manage multiple stores and monitor review activity efficiently.

- Proactive attitude toward resolving complaints and following up on pending concerns.

- Ability to work independently and complete assigned tasks within limited working hours.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets for tracking and weekly reporting.



### What We're Looking For



We want someone who does more than simply reply to reviews. You should actively identify potential issues, investigate suspicious reviews, follow up on unresolved complaints, and make sure no important review is left unattended.



**We value actual results, productivity, and initiative—not just logged working hours.**



### What We Offer



- Fully remote work opportunity.

- Flexible schedule of approximately 2–3 hours per day.

- Opportunity for a long-term working relationship based on performance.

- Training on our internal processes and review management procedures.

- Supportive team environment.



### How to Apply



Please send your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your experience in customer service, Trustpilot, online reputation management, or similar work.



In your application, please answer these questions:



1. Have you managed Trustpilot reviews before? If yes, how many accounts or stores?

2. Do you know how to identify and flag fake or suspicious Trustpilot reviews? Briefly explain your process.

3. How do you handle a negative review from a customer who has not responded to previous
s?

4. Are you comfortable working 2–3 hours per day and submitting weekly performance reports?

5. What is your expected hourly rate?



**Important:** 

Include the word **"trust"** in your application subject or introduction so we know you have read the entire job description.



We look forward to receiving your application!

title: AI Video Editor
description:
AI Video Creator / Editor: Heritage Health (DTC Supplement Startup)



(PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE THING)



What the job is:



We make organic short-form videos with Higgsfield. You’ll be producing 10-15 videos a day, each 10-15 seconds long. The edits are simple. What matters is how good you are at prompting and how fast you move.



Who you are:



20-28, young but proven. You’ve already got real reps. You’ve made AI videos that actually got views, and you’re still hungry with everything to prove.

You’re a prompting machine. You know Higgsfield inside and out (Seedance, Kling, image models, Genjutsu swaps) and you can get the shot you want in a few generations, not thirty. You know how to write a prompt that comes back looking real, not “AI-y.”

You live on TikTok and Reels. You know what’s trending, what hooks stop the scroll in the first second, and why one 12-second video does 2 million views while another does 400.

You’re fast. Short videos with simple edits mean volume is the game. 10-15 a day shouldn’t scare you.

You think for yourself. I don’t want to hold your hand. I want someone who comes to me with video ideas and new formats instead of waiting to be told what to make.

You know ecom and you’re tapped into the brands winning right now: Resilia, Lymphoria, Ryze, IM8. You understand what their organic content is doing and why it works.

You want to change your life. You’re ready to put your head down and grind 12+ hour days behind the laptop, locked in with a team that wants it just as bad, building something real from scratch.



Now the part I care about just as much:



I’ve hired people before who killed it on paper and then disappeared. Took a full day to answer a message. Moved slow. Weren’t hungry. Didn’t take it seriously. I’m done with that. I need someone who messages back fast, who’s genuinely willing to put in 12+ hour days, and who treats this like it’s theirs. If you’re lazy, if you ghost, if you need to be chased, don’t apply.



And straight up, if you don’t fit all of these requirements, don’t waste my time and don’t waste your time.

title: AI Automation Engineer (E-commerce)
description:
About the role

We are looking for a freelance AI Automation Engineer to build and run an agent system that operates our Shopify dropshipping business 24/7, with minimal human input.

We are a European e-commerce company with 7 years in Shopify dropshipping and more than 250 stores built. We run fashion stores for Europe (France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Poland, Denmark and more) and for the US and Canada. Today a human team handles the daily chain: product research, listing, creatives and ad launches. We want AI agents to take over most of that chain.

You live in the world of agentic AI. You know Claude, ChatGPT, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent inside out, and you have shipped agents that run on a server without babysitting. You design and build the system and hand it over fully working. One human controller on our side reviews and approves the key decisions.

• Type: freelance gig, project-based

• Location: fully remote

• Hours: flexible, with some overlap in the evening (CET)

The mission

Build five agents that run our daily chain on a server, around the clock.

Each agent hands its output to the next. The one fixed human step is a single approval before money is spent on ads.

What you will build

You own the system end to end, across five stages.

1. Product research

    ◦ Connect agents to Winninghunter (MCP/API) and scan daily for winning products, scaling ads and competitor stores.

    ◦ Score products on clear criteria: ad longevity, engagement, number of stores selling it, margin and shipping.

    ◦ Deliver a daily shortlist with the reasoning behind each pick.

2. Product launch

    ◦ Create products and collections in Shopify automatically via the Admin API or Shopify MCP.

    ◦ Generate product photos with AI (e.g. Higgsfield), plus titles, descriptions, variants and pricing.

    ◦ Write copy in the language of each market (French, Dutch, Polish, Danish, English).

    ◦ Apply the right conversion strategy: offers, bundles, upsells, social proof and page structure.

3. Creatives

    ◦ Turn competitor winning ads into new concepts: hooks, angles and offers.

    ◦ Design static and video ad creatives with AI image and video tools, in all needed formats.

    ◦ Write headlines and ad copy per market.

4. Ad launch

    ◦ Launch campaigns through the Meta Marketing API (Meta Ads MCP), with fixed naming, budgets and testing structure.

    ◦ Build in approval gates and hard spend limits, so no money goes out without the rules allowing it.

5. Deep analysis

    ◦ Pull ad metrics and Shopify orders daily and calculate real profit per product and per ad.

    ◦ Apply kill and scale rules, spot creative fatigue and suggest next tests.

    ◦ Feed the learnings back into research and creatives, so the system gets better every week.

Across all stages you also handle orchestration, logging, monitoring, error handling, API cost control, key security and clear documentation.

Tech stack

This is what we use today; you are free to propose better choices.

Area

Tools

AI models

Claude (API, Claude Code, Agent SDK), OpenAI / ChatGPT

Agent frameworks

OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, MCP servers

Product research

Winninghunter

Store

Shopify (Admin GraphQL API, Shopify MCP)

Creatives

Higgsfield and other AI image/video tools

Ads

Meta Ads (Marketing API / MCP), later TikTok Ads

Infrastructure

Linux server (VPS or cloud), Docker, Python and/or Node.js

Shared workspace

Google Drive and Google Sheets

Must-haves

• At least 2 years of hands-on work with LLM APIs, including agent systems running in production. You can show them.

• Deep knowledge of the Claude and OpenAI APIs: tool use, function calling, MCP, prompt design and context management.

• Hands-on experience with OpenClaw and/or Hermes Agent, and you can explain when to use which.

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, plus REST and GraphQL APIs and webhooks.

• Linux server skills: Docker, process managers, cron or queues, logging, monitoring and backups for 24/7 uptime.

• Experience with the Shopify Admin API and the Meta Marketing API.

• You understand e-commerce, not just code: what makes a winning product, what converts, and Meta metrics like CTR, CPM, CPC, CPA and ROAS.

• A security mindset: secrets management, scoped permissions and spend limits.

• Clear written English. You document everything you build.

• You work independently and proactively, without daily hand-holding.

Nice to have

• You have run a dropshipping store or bought Meta ads yourself.

• Experience with AI image and video tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney, Runway or Kling.

• Experience with spy tools like Winninghunter, Minea or PiPiADS.

• Copywriting skills in French, Dutch, Polish or Danish.

• Experience with the TikTok Ads API.

• Experience building evals to test prompt and agent quality.

• You can build simple dashboards for reporting and approvals.

Project milestones

Within 2 weeks, the full chain from research to analysis runs on the server, with a human only approving the key steps.

Phase

Deliverable

Done when

Milestone 1 (days 1–4)

Server live; research agent and product launch agent working

A daily product shortlist arrives automatically, and approved products go live in Shopify with photos and copy

Milestone 2 (days 5–9)

Creative agent and ad launch agent working

Creatives and campaigns are built automatically and launch after one approval, within spend limits

Milestone 3 (days 10–14)

Analysis agent and feedback loop working; documentation done

Daily profit reports, kill/scale suggestions and learnings flow back into research and creatives

What we offer

• A clear project with real ownership: you design the architecture.

• A competitive project fee, based on experience.

• Full access to the tools and API budget you need.

• Direct contact with the owner: short lines, fast decisions.

• A real business with real data, so you see the impact of your work right away.

• Fully remote, flexible hours.

How to apply

Send your application with the word AUTOPILOT in the subject line. Applications without it are not read.

Include:

1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. A short video (max 5 minutes, e.g. Loom) walking through an agent system you built and that runs in production.

3. Answers to these questions (max 1 page):

    ◦ How would you architect the five-stage pipeline above? Which tools would you use where?

    ◦ Which steps would you keep human-in-the-loop, and why?

    ◦ What would you estimate the monthly running cost to be (server plus API usage)?

    ◦ How do you prevent an agent from wasting ad budget when something goes wrong?

4. Your project quote (fixed price or hourly rate), estimated timeline and availability.

title: Full-Time General Manager / Head of Operations | UK Financial Firm
description:
A growing Europe-based financial firm is looking for a highly experienced Full-Time General Manager / Head of Operations to work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business.



THIS IS A SENIOR MANAGEMENT POSITION.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant role.

This is NOT an Executive Assistant role.

This is NOT an entry-level management role.



We are looking for someone who has already managed employees, business operations, KPIs, sales performance, company processes and daily operational activity.



The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the company operates efficiently every day without the CEO having to personally manage every employee, chase routine tasks or solve every operational problem.



You must be confident making decisions, managing staff, solving problems, improving systems, monitoring performance and holding employees accountable.



The CEO will remain responsible for overall strategy and major business decisions.



YOU will be responsible for making sure the business runs properly.





SALARY:



£5GBP-£7GBP per hour



Salary will depend on experience and proven ability.





WORKING HOURS:



Monday to Friday



9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK TIME



40 HOURS PER WEEK



FULL-TIME ONLY

You must be able to START WITHIN THE NEXT 7 DAYS.





MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:





DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS:



- Take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the company

- Manage daily and weekly operational priorities

- Ensure employees complete their responsibilities

- Monitor deadlines and outstanding tasks

- Identify operational problems and resolve them quickly

- Build and improve company systems

- Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Make routine operational decisions independently

- Ensure the company remains organised, productive and accountable

- Reduce unnecessary CEO involvement in routine operational matters





STAFF MANAGEMENT:



- Directly manage company employees

- Monitor staff performance

- Follow up incomplete work

- Hold employees accountable for targets and deadlines

- Conduct staff meetings

- Monitor attendance and productivity

- Address performance issues

- Identify when additional employees are required

- Ensure every employee understands their responsibilities





KPI & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT:



- Create clear KPIs for employees

- Monitor daily, weekly and monthly performance

- Identify underperformance quickly

- Implement performance improvement plans

- Review staff productivity

- Prepare management reports

- Track results against targets

- Ensure employees are producing measurable results rather than simply appearing busy





SALES OPERATIONS:



- Oversee the B2B sales function

- Monitor sales activity and performance

- Review CRM activity

- Monitor sales follow-ups

- Ensure opportunities are being progressed

- Review the sales pipeline

- Track meetings, opportunities, conversions and signed clients

- Hold sales employees accountable for results

- Identify problems affecting sales performance

- Work with the sales team to improve results





LEAD GENERATION OVERSIGHT:

- Monitor lead quantity and quality

- Ensure decision-maker information is properly researched

- Prevent duplicate, poor-quality or fabricated data entering the CRM

- Ensure the sales team has sufficient quality prospects to contact





CRM MANAGEMENT:



- Ensure CRM records are accurate and updated

- Monitor lead and client stages

- Check employee CRM activity

- Ensure calls,
s, follow-ups and next actions are recorded

- Ensure opportunities are not forgotten

- Maintain consistent CRM standards across the business





CLIENT & CASE OPERATIONS:



- Oversee new client onboarding

- Ensure client information and documents are properly recorded

- Monitor active client matters

- Ensure client communication is professional and timely

- Oversee the operational handover from sales to service delivery

- Monitor case progress

- Ensure important issues are escalated appropriately





FINANCIAL & BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION:



- Monitor operational expenses and subscriptions

- Review basic company financial reports

- Work with bookkeeping/accounting support when required

- Monitor invoices and payment administration

- Maintain accurate operational and financial records

- Identify unnecessary business costs

- Provide the CEO with clear company performance summaries





CEO REPORTING:



You will report directly to the CEO.



The CEO should NOT need to spend every day asking:



What is each employee doing?

Has this task been completed?

Why has this client not been followed up?

Why has the CRM not been updated?

Why are targets being missed?

Who is responsible for this problem?



You will be expected to know the answers.



You will provide a clear weekly management report covering:



- Staff performance

- Sales performance

- Lead generation

- Client activity

- KPIs

- Operational problems

- Outstanding priorities

- Decisions requiring CEO approval





MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS:



- MINIMUM 5 YEARS' PROVEN SENIOR MANAGEMENT / OPERATIONS EXPERIENCE

- COMPLETED BACHELOR'S DEGREE OR HIGHER – REQUIRED

- Previous experience as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Head of Operations, COO, Business Manager or directly comparable senior position

- Sales operations

THIS ROLE IS NOT SUITABLE FOR SOMEONE WHO:

- Has only worked as an Executive Assistant

- Has never managed KPIs

IMPORTANT:



THIS IS A SENIOR MANAGEMENT POSITION.



We are NOT looking for someone to learn how to become a manager.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to manage employees and RUN DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS.



You will receive training on our specific company, services, systems and internal processes.

False or materially misleading information may result in rejection of your application and may be reported to OnlineJobs.ph where appropriate.





HOW TO APPLY:



⚠️ MINIMUM 30 APPLY POINTS REQUIRED



⚠️ APPLICATION CODE REQUIRED:



COO30-UKOPS26



You MUST place this code at the VERY TOP of your application:



COO30-UKOPS26



Applications using fewer than 30 Apply Points will NOT be considered.



Applications without the correct application code will NOT be considered.





PLEASE ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS:





QUESTION 1:



How many years have you worked in senior management or operations positions?





QUESTION 2:



What is your CURRENT job?



By CURRENT, we mean the job you are working in RIGHT NOW today.

QUESTION 3:

QUESTION 8:

QUESTION 9:



Which CRM, project-management, finance and business-management systems have you used?





QUESTION 10:

QUESTION 15:

QUESTION 16:

FINAL WARNING:



You must:

title: Senior Content Producer — Short/Long-Form Video & Graphic Carousels
description:
Senior Content Producer (Short-Form Video, Long-Form Video & Graphic Carousels)



Company: Maverick Creative Group

Job type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Schedule: US Pacific Time, including a required daily review call, 9:00 to 11:00 AM PT

Reports to: Operations Lead



ABOUT THE ROLE



Maverick Creative Group is a fast-growing digital growth agency and media production engine. We build scalable marketing systems, high-converting offer funnels and automated media engines that help brands win customers across multiple channels.



This is not a one-video-a-day editing job. It's a systems-driven production role built on templates, batches, a daily review and a clear standard for what "done" means. If you build systems, hit your numbers and take feedback fast, you'll do well here.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Short-form video: 20 to 25 finished Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts per day

- Graphic carousels: 5 to 10 slide carousels for Instagram, 
 and

- Long-form video: 10 to 30 minute podcasts, YouTube breakdowns and software walkthroughs

- Synthetic media: AI presenter clips when raw human footage isn't available

- Screen captures: vertical 9:16 desktop software demos

- Quality control: safe zones, spelling, pricing and claims



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY TO DAY



- Produce 20 to 25 finished short-form videos a day, targeting 100+ approved assets per week at full ramp

- Work from brand design systems and a hook library, turning one source recording into multiple variants

- Design carousels in Canva, Photoshop or Illustrator, with a strong hook on slide one, a clean visual hierarchy and consistent branding on every slide

- Edit long-form content, including multi-cam sync, audio cleanup and retention pacing, and cut each long recording into Shorts and clips

- Create AI presenter clips in HeyGen or Descript, always labelled as AI-generated where the platform requires it. A generated presenter never appears as a customer, patient or reviewer, and any real person's likeness or voice requires written consent on file first

- Record and format vertical 9:16 demos of Maverick CRM workflows, with zoom-ins, voiceover and mobile-readable text

- Design high-contrast end cards and keyword callouts (for example, "Comment LAUNCH below") that feed our comment-automation funnels

- Keep text and logos clear of platform UI buttons, and run a QA checklist on every piece before review: zero typos, prices exactly as printed on the Master Product & Pricing Sheet, and no unapproved claims

- Name files consistently (for example, MCG_D07_video_ProductA_v1), log every piece in the shared register the same day, and apply the tracking link supplied for each piece

- Apply feedback from the morning review call quickly and completely



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong portfolio with all three: short-form reels, graphic carousels and long-form video edits

- Proven daily output at volume, shown with real examples and your measured minutes per piece

- Skill in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects or CapCut

- Skill in Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva

- Experience with HeyGen, Descript and a desktop screen recorder

- Working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram,
, LinkedIn and YouTube formats

- Availability on US Pacific hours, including the 9:00 to 11:00 AM PT review call every day

- A reliable computer and internet connection, a quiet workspace, and two-factor authentication on work accounts



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with comment-to-DM automation funnels

- Experience in real estate, home services or B2B agencies



CONTENT STANDARDS YOU'LL FOLLOW



- Video: 9:16 at 1080 x 1920. Carousels: 4:5 at 1080 x 1350 (unless told otherwise)

- Brand colors: Navy #0A1420, Gold #C9A24B, Ivory #ECEBE3

- Fonts: Playfair Display for headlines, Inter for body text

- Licensed music only, with a license you can show on request

- No results, earnings or ranking claims, and no testimonials or ratings

- Every Maverick AI employee is introduced as an AI



HIRING PROCESS



1. Portfolio and resume review

2. 30-minute interview covering your output, template workflow, compliance judgment and availability for the daily review call

3. Paid 5-day trial batch. You'll work from a source pack, deliver a defined batch of finished pieces and apply revisions from the morning review calls. We score you on:

- Speed: pieces delivered and your self-logged minutes per piece

- Accuracy: zero compliance, pricing or typo misses

- Revisions: how fast and how completely you apply feedback

- First-pass approval: at least 90% of pieces approved without rework



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a complete application with the subject line "Senior Content Producer - [Your Name]":



1. Your resume

2. Links to at least 3 short-form reels, 2 carousels and 1 long-form video edit

3. Short answers to these two questions:

- How many finished short-form pieces do you produce on a typical day, and how long does each take you?

- Can you attend a daily 9:00 to 11:00 AM Pacific review call? What time is that for you?

4. Your earliest start date



Applications missing portfolio links or answers may not be reviewed.

title: GoHighLevel CRM and Automation Specialist (Executive Assistant – Beauty & E-Commerce
description:
We are a fast-growing beauty business and e-commerce brand looking for a GoHighLevel specialist to help build, organize, and manage our backend systems.  



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. You will be responsible for building and maintaining systems that drive leads, sales, and client experience.  



You must be proactive, detail-oriented, organized, and experienced in GoHighLevel or a very similar CRM. You should be able to think in systems, not just complete tasks.  



Core Responsibilities:  



CRM and Pipeline Management 

Build and manage pipelines inside 

GoHighLevel 

Organize leads, opportunities, and client journeys 

Maintain clean and accurate contact data  

Automations and Workflows 

Set up workflows such as missed call text back, follow-ups, and nurture sequences 

Build and troubleshoot automations 

Optimize systems to improve conversion and client experience   


 and Lead Generation Systems 

Build and manage
 campaigns 

Set up lead capture systems including forms, funnels, and landing pages 

Assist with campaign execution such as “10 clients in 10 days” style promotions  



Tracking and Optimization Track leads and conversions 

Pull basic weekly metrics Identify gaps and suggest improvements  



Executive Support (Systems Focused) 

Organize business tasks within GoHighLevel or project tools Support backend setup and ongoing improvements 

Keep systems and projects moving forward  



Requirements: Experience with GoHighLevel or a very similar CRM Strong organization and attention to detail Ability to follow instructions and improve systems 

Reliable communication  



Application Process:  



Step 1: Loom Video (5–10 minutes maximum)  



Record a Loom video answering the following:  



Pipeline Setup Show or explain how you would set up a basic pipeline in GoHighLevel for new leads, booked, completed, and follow-up stages  



Automation Thinking Explain how you would set up a missed call text back workflow and what steps you would include  



Organization and Systems Given tasks such as building
 campaigns, outreach to partners, managing leads, and tracking follow-ups, explain how you would organize this inside a system 



 Step 2: Written Task  Write a simple follow-up message for a missed call lead  



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.  



Hours and Pay: Part-time to start with, opportunity to grow Compensation based on experience

title: Full-Time Senior B2B Sales Executive | CRM, Email Outreach, Cold Calling & ClosingFull-Time Senior B2B Sales Executive |
description:
JOB TITLE:

Full-Time Senior B2B Sales Executive | CRM,
 Outreach, Cold Calling & Closing



JOB DESCRIPTION:



A growing Finance-based online business is looking for a highly experienced full-time Senior B2B Sales Executive.



This is a serious revenue-generating role.



You will be responsible for managing the full outbound sales process from first contact to signed client.



This includes:



- CRM management

-
 outreach

- Cold calling

- Follow-ups

- Lead qualification

- Appointment setting

- Pipeline management

- Objection handling

- Closing

- Reporting

- Revenue generation



THIS IS NOT A BASIC APPOINTMENT SETTING ROLE.



THIS IS NOT A CUSTOMER SERVICE ROLE.



THIS IS NOT A TRAINING ROLE.



You must already be an experienced B2B salesperson who understands how to take a cold lead, build interest, qualify the opportunity, follow up professionally, and help turn that prospect into a paying client.



You will be working with UK business prospects, primarily in the construction sector.



You must be confident speaking with:



- CEOs

- Managing Directors

- Finance Directors

- Commercial Directors

- Business Owners

- Senior Managers



You will be expected to take ownership of your sales pipeline and produce measurable ROI.

QUESTION 1:

How many years of proven B2B sales experience do you have, and what was your most recent sales role?

QUESTION 2:

What products or services have you sold, and which types of decision-makers did you usually speak to?

QUESTION 3:

What measurable sales results did you personally achieve in your last role? Please include figures such as revenue generated, deals closed, conversion rate, appointments booked, or target achieved.

QUESTION 4:

Explain how you manage a cold prospect from first
 or call through to follow-up and closing the deal.

QUESTION 5:

Give one example of a difficult objection you received from a prospect and explain exactly how you handled it.

QUESTION 6:

Are you available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM UK time, and can you start within the next 7 days? Please also provide your WhatsApp number including country code.

IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING

⚠️ MINIMUM 40 APPLY POINTS REQUIRED

⚠️ APPLICATION CODE REQUIRED: SALES40-UKCLOSE26

You must apply using:

40 Apply Points minimum

Application Code: SALES40-UKCLOSE26

Please include the application code SALES40-UKCLOSE26 at the very top of your application.

Applications with fewer than 40 Apply Points will not be considered.

Applications that do not include the correct application code will not be considered.

This is a senior B2B sales role requiring a minimum of 5 years’ proven sales experience.



DO NOT APPLY IF:

- You have less than 5 years’ proven B2B sales experience

- You only have customer service experience

- You only have inbound sales experience

- You are looking for basic sales training

- You are uncomfortable with cold calling

- You cannot manage CRM,
 outreach and follow-ups

- You cannot demonstrate measurable sales results

- You cannot work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM UK time

- You cannot start within the next 7 days

Your previous employment, references and sales results may be verified.

False, exaggerated or materially misleading experience may be rejected and reported to OnlineJobs.ph where appropriate.

TO APPLY:

Start your application with:

SALES40-UKCLOSE26
